_lecture: Notes de fonctionnement des augments de warframe, extraites du wiki le 13/11/2026.
Abating Link:
- Armor reduction is affected by Ability Strength, fully removing Armor at 167% Ability Strength.
- Armor reduction is temporary, enemies will regain their Armor when no longer tethered.
Conseils :
- With one player using Corrosive Projection, 100% Armor reduction can be achieved at 137% Ability Strength.
Abundant Mutation:
- Damage from Virulence and maggots spawned from Ravenous scales with the increased max stacks.
- Not affected by Ability Strength.
- If Nidus reaches 0 Health during the 30 seconds cooldown period on Undying, Nidus will go into Bleedout and lose all stacks of Mutations.
Accumulating Whipclaw:
- Damage bonus is additive to the one provided by Ability Strength.
  - This diminishes the effectiveness of modding for Ability Strength alongside the Augment.
- Damage bonus caps at 350%, or after hitting 3 or more enemies 10 times.
  - Whipclaw itself must hit the enemies to get a bonus: hitting them through Strangledome's range extension alone does not count.
  - Only one stack is granted per cast of Whipclaw; hitting 6 or more enemies will not grant additional stacks.
- Damage bonus decays at a rate of 2.5% per second.
- Damage bonus and decay rate are not affected by mods.
- Damage bonus resets after falling or being nullified.
- The -2.5% per second decay starts after the 10 second "grace period" you get after hitting 3 enemies with one Whipclaw. Meaning that, after those first 10 seconds, it would take another 14 seconds for it to gradually remove 35% worth of buffs.
- The long decay time makes it very easy to keep this buff maxed or near maxed for an entire mission in most cases.
Aegis Gale:
- Alternate Fire has no charge time, immediately beginning a burst-fire volley of 4 projectiles. Each individual shot in the volley has the same stats as an uncharged Balefire shot, including:
  - 100 shield cost (400 per volley).
  - 500 base damage plus a bonus 15% of Hildryn's max shields, all dealt as pure Electricity damage.
    - Bonus damage is added to the shot's base damage before weapon mods are applied, and thus can be increased by mods such as Hornet Strike and Heated Charge.
    - Bonus damage is calculated upon casting Aegis Storm, snapshotting Hildryn's current ability strength and maximum shield capacity. Does not consider Overshields.
  - 5% critical chance.
  - 1.5x critical multiplier.
  - 10% status chance.
- Has an approximate Fire Rate of 1.6 shots per second when constantly holding down the alt-fire button, affected by fire rate bonuses.
  - There is a delay of approximately 0.4s between each shot in the volley, and 1.3s between the last shot in one volley and the first shot of the next, giving a total time of 2.5s per 4 shots.
Conseils :
- Arcane Expertise synergizes incredibly well with this augment. It will cause ability strength to increase both her maximum shields and the alt-fire's scaling with max shields, giving the alt-fire quadratic scaling with strength.
  - Single use buffs like Energy Conversion and Empower will increase Hildryn's max shields while active. Both the shield and strength bonus will be snapshotted upon casting Aegis Storm and applied to the alt-fire's damage for the duration of the ability cast.
- Precision Intensify also has amazing synergy. When Balefire is summoned by casting Aegis Storm, Balefire will receive the massive strength bonus from the mod. The strength bonus also gives a large increase to the max shield scaling on the alt-fire.
  - When combined with Arcane Expertise, the strength bonus will be converted into +90% max shield capacity whenever Aegis Storm is Hildryn's currently selected ability (by default Mouse Wheel on PC). This grants a huge increase to both max shield capacity and max shield scaling at the same time.
- Primed Redirection on its own is a huge increase to the alt-fire damage, but also makes each point of ability strength an even more potent damage increase.
- As the alt-fire has an extremely sluggish fire rate, some form of fire rate bonus is recommended, such as Arcane Velocity or Anemic Agility (or at least Lethal Torrent).
- Like with Balefire's main firing mode, the alt-fire suffers from an incredibly low critical chance. Secondary Enervate can allow it to make use of critical hits, granting a large damage multiplier when combined with a critical damage bonus like Primed Target Cracker or Tenacious Bond.
Afterburn:
- Afterburn's damage is determined by how long Spectral Scream had been active, with a maximum cap on the damage that can be dealt.
  - Damage is affected by Ability Strength.
  - Range is 3m and not be affected by Ability Range.
  - The damage dealt at max rank is enough to instantly kill a player in the Conclave.
Airburst Rounds:
- Total maximum damage bonus is capped at 500%.
  - Maximum damage bonus is not affected by Ability Strength.
- Damage bonus per enemy hit is affected by Ability Strength.
  - Enemies struck by both the Airburst projectile directly and the explosion will provide twice the bonus per enemy hit this way.
- Damage bonus additively stacks with base damage mods such as Hornet Strike.
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Duration can be refreshed by recasting the ability and hitting at least one enemy.
  - Refreshing keeps the highest bonus between the old and new Airbursts.
- Applies to Hildryn's Balefire Charger, Dante's Noctua, and Jade's Glory.
- Does not apply to Mesa's Regulators and Titania's Dex Pixia.
Conseils :
- Cast an Airburst vortex once to group enemies to strike them all directly with a second Airburst, maximizing the bonus per enemy.
Ambush: - Gives a damage buff additive to mods like Serration to the player's equipped weapon.
Anchored Glide: - Only disables the reduced gravity aspect of the passive. The increased crit chance bonus while in midair is unaffected.
Antimatter Absorb:
- Absorbing radius is affected by Ability Range.
- Tthe absorbing can provide up to 25k additional damage to the final explosion
- Using the augment while aiming may result in the drop becoming stuck in Nova’s hand and automatically detonating after a few seconds. This may be used as an emergency shield however, providing protection to gunfire from all directions.
Antimatter Mine:
Conseils :
- As ranking up this mod decreases the duration of the mine it can be beneficial to leave it unranked so it lasts longer. However it is unknown if ranking up the mod increases the enemy detection range which, if this were the case, would create a dilemma in choosing between higher duration or range.
Assimilate:
- Players can perform the revive action, fire primary/secondary weapons, melee attacks, jump, and interact with objects (hacking terminals, power cells, etc.) during Assimilate.
- While Assimilate is active, the invulnerability bubble extends to robotic companions (such as Sentinels, MOAs, and Hounds) floating or attached near Nyx, rendering them completely immune to damage and status effects.
  - Beast companions (such as Kavats and Kubrows) do not stay fixed inside the bubble when pathing away from Nyx, so they can still take damage.
- Self-stagger from explosive weapons like the Lenz or Ogris will notapply when this augment is active.
- Assimilate will end if Nyx runs out of energy, or if deactivated by pressing the ability key again (default 4 ).
  - Nyx cannot replenish energy using Energy Vampire, Rally Point, Rift Plane's innate energy regeneration, Squad Energy Restores, Energy Siphon, Energy Nexus, Dreamer's Bond, Wellspring, Rage, and/or Hunter Adrenaline while Assimilate is active.
  - The energy drain from Assimilate will not be converted to Shields by Brief Respite or the Augur Mods.
  - Energy can be replenished by Energy Orbs, Orokin Void Death Orb's energy restores, Equilibrium, Spellbound Harvest, Arcane Energize, and Emergence Dissipate's Energy Motes while the ability is active.
- Allows ally bullets and projectiles to pass through Absorb.
- Ally bullets and projectiles that passed through Absorb with Assimilate have their Critical Damage doubled, similar to Electric Shield.
  - Critical damage bonus doesn't stack with Electric Shield.
  - Doesn't apply to Nyx' own attacks.
Conseils :
- Rift Strike can be used to reach distant enemies and gain ground, though players will need to perform Heavy Attacks.
- Electromagnetic Shielding can be used to absorb some of the damage that nearby allies receive while also retaining a fast movement speed by using Final Harbinger's Dark Light combo.
- Some melee weapons and combos may be used to bypass the movement penalty, such as the Blind Justice Nikana stance's Guiding Light combo.
- Using Dispatch Overdrive will grant you more movement speed during Assimilate.
- Switching to the Operator or Drifter can allow the player to use Void Dash and get to objectives quicker while still keeping Assimilate active on Nyx.
- While equipping Assimilate, casting Absorb during Aim Glide will not stop or slow down the maneuver until Nyx touches the ground.
- As Nyx cannot slide or sprint during Assimilate, negative % Friction mods such as Cunning Drift, Maglev, and Streamlined Form or Sprint Speed mods such as Rush or Speed Drift provide no benefit.
- Assimilate prevents the health loss from Combat Discipline, while still being able to heal allies and trigger Arcane Avenger.
- Amalgam Barrel Diffusion will increase roll distance and speed.
- As Assimilate still allows the use of Nyx's other abilities, mobility related subsumes like Reave, Wrathful Advance, Fire Walker or Infested Mobility may be of great use.
Axios Javelineers:
- Normally Axios Javelin only spawns a vortex if you directly strike an enemy with the ability while this augment throws three javelins each with a guaranteed vortex on throw.
- When directly hitting enemies with any of the Javelins, the vortex duration is increased by an additional 5 seconds, affected by Ability Duration.
  - Vortex duration without this augment is set at 2 seconds, unaffected by mods.
  - Precise hits with high Ability Range allows the vortex to fully pull in enemies that are further away.
Balefire Surge:
- Nullifier shields are permanently destroyed (same as killing their shield drone).
- Does not affect any other enemy shielding ability (e.g. Arctic Eximus).
- Shield restore is affected by Power Strength.
- Direct hits from multishots will also restore shields.
- Can grant overshields.
- Punch Through will prevent direct hits (except for nullifier shields), negating much of the augment.
- Does not destroy the nullifier shield on sortie hijack missions.
Ballistic Bullseye:
- Critical Chance bonus is applied after mods, the same way as Arcane Avenger and Covenant.
- Critical Chance bonus is applied to all projectiles fired, rather than just the projectile boosted by Ballistic Battery
- Critical Chance bonus is multiplied by Multishot on beams without a radial component (e.g. Ocucor, Nukor, and Enkaus)
- Critical Chance bonus applies to melees, with some exceptions
  - Exceptions include, but are not limited to, Exodia Contagion, Tenet Exec Waves, and Sampotes Waves
- Scales with Ability Strength.
Beguiling Lantern:
- Weapon Damage Vulnerability is affected by Ability Strength.
- Does not affect damage over time (except for Blast).
- Affects Razorwing's Dex Pixia and Diwata, as well as Razorflies.
Biting Frost:
- Critical Chance and Multiplier bonuses apply to all weapon types, including primary, secondary, and melee.
  - Bonuses are not affected by Ability Strength.
  - Bonuses are additive to similar mods such as Point Strike and Vital Sense.
- Effects that rapidly apply 10 Cold stacks include:
  - Frost's Freeze's direct hit
  - Frost's Snow Globe's activation while within its range
  - Frost's Avalanche
  - Gauss' Thermal Sunder double cast (Helminth subsumable) or with Redline active
  - Voruna's Fangs of Raksh (applies 5 random status effects which may include Cold)
  - Itzal's Cosmic Crush with Cold Snap augment
  - Cyte-09's Neutralizer's alternate fire grenade
- Enemies are not "frozen" by:
  - Petrify
  - Condemn
- Also affects abilities which are treated as weapons, such as Breach Surge sparks.
  - Most of these abilities have 0% base critical chance, meaning the critical chance buff has no effect.
    - The critical damage bonus can still be taken advantage of when combined with flat critical chance bonuses that affect abilities, such as Arcane Avenger and Covenant.
- Enemies that have status caps, such as units with Overguard active or Acolytes will not be affected by Biting Frost as they cannot be frozen.
Blazing Pillage:
- Heat damage and shield restore are affected by Ability Strength.
  - Because Heat procs will temporarily reduce half of an enemy's current armor rating, this makes Pillage itself more efficient as enemies on fire will have half of the remaining armor that Pillage strips, as long as they stay on fire.
- Blazing Pillage will only trigger on enemies marked by the expanding pulse, while linked to Hildryn with Haven activated.
Conseils :
- This Augment gives Hildryn a much-needed edge against the Infested as the overall lack of armor or shields in this faction makes Pillage as it is far less effective against them, in turn making it more diffcult for Hildryn to restore her shields.
Blending Talons:
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
- Combo count chance is not affected by mods.
- Blending Talons' explosion applies all effects of Seeking Talons to enemies in range, ignoring Line of Sight.
Blinding Reave:
- Blind duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Blinded enemies are susceptible to melee finishers.
- Enemies under Enthrall can be blinded by this augment.
Blood Forge:
- This mod works effectively for both primary and secondary weapons, as well as Archguns with Gravimags, as long as Garuda is actively using them.
- Reloaded ammo is taken from the equipped weapon's ammo reserves. This mod does not generate ammo.
- Works well with weapons with slow reload speed (e.g. Nagantaka, Arca Plasmor (Tenet), Gorgon and its variants).
- Affects weapons that reload one round at a time (e.g. Strun, Corinth, Zarr (Kuva), Felarx), resulting in a very quick full reload.
- Does not count as a reload for certain conditional effects that reset on reload, including:
  - Status chance and multishot stacks from Sobek & Kuva Sobek's Clip Delegation
  - Critical chance and critical damage from Hema & Coda Hema's Necrophagic Vigor
  - Auto-targeting tendrils from Ocucor's passive
  - Various Incarnon perks:
    - Punch through, projectile speed, and fire rate from Felarx's Dual-Mode Chamber and Mounting Momentum
    - Damage increase from Boar Incarnon Genesis & Lato Incarnon Genesis' Reified Bane
    - Multishot from Sybaris Incarnon Genesis & Strun Incarnon Genesis' Blazing Barrel
    - Damage increase from Sybaris Incarnon Genesis's Well Rehearsed and Reaver's Rapture
  - Soma Prime with Hata-Satya will not retain its critical chance bonus when reloaded using Blood Forge.
  - The Cold blast from Aksondol's passive will not trigger when Blood Forge is activated.
  - Cyte-09's elemental ammo from Resupply.
Brood's Oversurge:
- Replaces Scuttlers' Toxin damage with Electricity damage with a forced status effect.
- Holding Widow's Brood (default 3 ) consumes 10 Energy and directs all active Scuttlers at an aimed enemy. Directed Scuttlers inflict 2000 Electricity damage in a 5 meter radius around the enemy.
  - If no enemy is within the reticle, the directed attack cannot be performed.
- Scuttlers can still proc Archon Continuity with their standard, non-directed attack. The directed attack from this augment, however, does not.
Calm & Frenzy:
- Spread radius is affected by ability range.
- Remaining duration on spread is not affected by mods.
- Line of sight is not required to spread the effect.
Capacitance:
- Can create Overshields.
- Affected allies includes all Warframes, Companions, Eidolon Lures, summoned allied units such as Specters, allied Invasion units, Hostages, Kavor Defectors, Sortie and Arbitrations Defense Operatives, and Defense Objects.
  - On Defense Objects, their shield gain is capped at 250, and do not gain overshields.
- Shield bonus is affected by Ability Strength, but the amount per second also seems to be an average instead of a static number, and can fluctuate for each tick dealt on enemies even if the damage remains the same.
- This augment works best the more enemies there are in a group, due to how Discharge works, zapping each other and increasing the amount of bulk shield obtained within the first moments of the cast.
Conseils :
- Mods like Fast Deflection and Fortitude can be used to increase Volt's shield recharge rate, allowing overshields to add up sooner.
- Enemies trapped in a vortex of Vauban's Bastille will all be hit at the same time, and will shock every enemy inside at once causing potentially massive bulks of shields each second as well as increased DPS of the ability. This also allows a low Power Range build to be viable.
- Casting Electric Shield before casting can prevent some damage to Volt and his allies when casting, as the base ability prevents Volt from moving, and may only slowly regenerate shielding.
Cataclysmic Continuum:
- The Duration Bonus is not affected by Ability Duration.
- This mod does not increase the duration beyond the maximum duration of Cataclysm, and the added seconds do not increase the Cataclysm's size neither do they stop it from shrinking. The increased duration does however decrease the shrinking speed.
  - The reduction of Cataclysm's radius with the augment equipped is summed up in the following formula: Reduction = 2 × Base Radius × (1 + Range Mods) ÷ (3 × Base Duration × (1 + Duration Mods) + Augment Duration Bonus)
  - While the mod does reduce the shrinking rate of Cataclysm, it does not prevent it from reaching its minimum radius, though the augment does allow players to maintain the bubble at minimum radius indefinitely as long as they kill enemies in the bubble.
- The effect only occurs when an enemy dies within the bubble. It still occurs when a Warframe outside the bubble kills an enemy within, but it does not occur when a Warframe within the bubble kills an enemy outside it.
Cataclysmic Gate:
- No longer a channeled ability with an energy drain over time.
- Blasts three solar plasma beams from Wisp and her spectral images for up to 1 second, then explodes for 5000 radial Heat damage in a 10m, creating a spherical sun portal at the reticle location. Sun portal inflicts 500 damage per half second, evenly split between Impact, Puncture, and Slash, in a 10m area, with guaranteed status effects of Heat and Radiation per tick of damage.
  - Sol Gate's plasma beam phase can be skipped by pressing the ability button again (default 4 ), instantly deploying the sun portal.
  - Explosion and damage per half second damage and break destructible Objects in range.
- Sun portals are enhanced by Reservoirs synergies.
  - The Haste Mote applies an additional guaranteed Corrosive status from every tick of sun portal damage.
  - The Vitality and Shock Motes each grant a 25% total damage bonus to the sun portal damage. Unlike Sol Gate, the 25% bonus from the two motes do not stack, giving only a 25% bonus whether 1 or both buffs are active (likely a bug).
- Sun portal damage radius is affected by Ability Range and duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Max 3 sun portals can be active at once.
- Sun portal damage per half second (but not the initial explosion damage) is affected by Universal Weapon Bonuses, such as Arcane Arachne and Nourish.
  - Sun portal damage per half second has 0% critical chance (not buffable even with flat bonuses like Arcane Avenger) and 0% status chance (only has forced procs).
- Sun portals are visually placed halfway into the surface on the reticle.
- Sun portals require Line of Sight if the enemy is not within 5m.
Catapult:
- Energy cost is affected by Ability Efficiency.
- Once Catapult is activated, Grendel is launched toward the direction of the aiming reticle at his current speed plus 25 m/s, during which his field of vision widens considerably.
- Colliding into obstacles including enemies and terrain will not decelerate Grendel while Catapult is still in effect.
- Crouching during the Catapult will reduce Grendel's speed.
Cathode Current:
- Bonuses are not affected by mods.
- Rotorswell duration is increased by the same amount as Cathode Grace on kill. As such, its duration cannot be increased beyond the base duration plus 60 seconds.
Celestial Stomp:
- Affected enemies will be suspended in the air for 6 seconds, and need 2 additional seconds to stand up and recover.
  - Stun duration is not affected by Ability Duration.
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
  - Does not require line of sight and can affect enemies behind walls and obstacles.
- Deals 100 Blast damage with ~10% status chance to affected enemies.
  - Damage is not affected by Ability Strength.
  - Enemies cannot be damaged by subsequent slams until they have recovered from being suspended.
- Wukong cannot unsummon/cancel Celestial Twin while Celestial Stomp is equipped.
- Functions very similarly to Rhino Stomp, both in its slow strength on suspended enemies, and its CC effectiveness reduction against bosses and minibosses.
Champion's Blessing:
- The Champion's Blessing buff applies only to the ability caster.
- Any ally healed with Blessing will trigger Champion's Blessing, including Warframes, Specters, and Companions, whether from other players, NPCs, or the self.
  - Combat Discipline can be used to deliberately inflict self-damage.
    - Note that Combat Discipline's self-damage is affected by damage-reducing abilities, such as Link and Blessing.
  - Link Vitality is recalculated when transferring to Operator/Drifter and lost health is not automatically recovered when transferring back to Trinity. Transferring and casting Blessing repeatedly allows a reliable way to stack the buff.
- Only restored Health counts towards the bonus; restoring Shields has no effect.
- Casting multiple Blessings will reset the buff timer.
  - Critical chance from multiple blessings will be added together up to the 350% maximum.
- Critical chance bonus is additive with other sources of critical chance bonus.
- The duration of Champion's Blessing is affected by Ability Duration.
- Champion's Blessing has a longer duration than Blessing and will continue to function until its own duration expires.
- Champion's Blessing can be stripped by nullification effects such as Stalker's Dispel or a Nullifier Crewman's shield.
Chaos Sphere:
- Upon casting Chaos, a circular radius shown as a wall of energy is laid down on the location where the ability was cast. Any enemies entering through this radius will receive 10 Radiation status effects. This area-of-effect is stationary, and will not move along with Nyx.
  - The radius of this effect slowly shrinks within the duration of the Chaos Sphere's effect.
  - The shrinking radius of the effect is often faster than the speed of the advancing enemies, thus limiting the usefulness of this augment.
- The Chaos ability timer will terminate if Chaos Sphere reaches the end of its duration and there are no more enemies affected by Chaos, whether from the initial cast or from the Chaos Sphere.
Chilling Globe:
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Enemies are frozen upon crossing the Snow Globe's perimeter.
  - Enemies that are not frozen cannot be frozen until they exit and reenter the globe.
Chromatic Blade:
- Status chance bonus is additive with other status chance mods and is affected by Ability Strength.
  - Total Status Chance = Base status chance × [1 + (Chromatic Blade Bonus × (1 + Strength Mods)) + Status Mods]
  - For example, using a maxed Intensify, Drifting Contact, and Chromatic Blade results in: 0.15 × [1 + ( 3 × 1.3) + 0.4] = 79.5% status chance
  - Achieving 100% status chance without any status chance mods requires 189%Ability Strength.
- Chromatic Blade's color selection is based on Excalibur's primary emission color:
  - White, grey, black, and some faded colors make Cold.
  - Blue and purple hues make Electricity.
  - Red, magenta, brown, orange, and bright yellow hues make Heat.
  - Green, lime, teal, and dark yellow hues make Toxin.
  - Purchasing color palettes is not required to unlock all the elemental options.
  - While customizing Excalibur's emission color, Chromatic Blade's active element is indicated by an icon (Heat, Electricity, Toxin, Cold). This imgur album can serve as a reference for future color palette purchases.
  - Customizing the secondary emission and the energy colors will have no effect.
  - The Arthur Gemini Skin swaps between appearance configs, allowing the player to color for two separate elements and swap between them with the Gemini Emote.
- Chromatic Blade's elemental damage replaces the innate physical elements and will combine with any elemental damage modded on Exalted Blade.
- Physical damage mods will no longer affect Exalted Blade's damage with Chromatic Blade equipped.
Coil Recharge:
- Has a duration of 20 seconds, after which it will detonate.
- Has a discharge range of 5 meters.
- Discharges every 4 seconds. Every 25 meters traveled, the sphere will discharge to an additional enemy and reduce the discharge timer by 0.5 seconds down to a minimum of 0.25 seconds at 225 meters.
- Upon detonation, releases one additional electrical discharge per 15 meters traveled over approximately 2 seconds, with a minimum of one discharge
- All Discharges chain between enemies, hitting up to 5 enemies per discharge.
- Critical hits from Coil Recharge's discharge will trigger Rotorswell's discharge.
- On recall, the Gyratory Sphere will sling itself towards Gyre's current position, stopping in front of her, facilitating a melee strike to the sphere to fling it at the reticle's direction.
Cold Front:
- Provides a 25% increase to parkour velocity while Snow Globe is active.
- Base Ability Range is reduced to 2.25m and mods, such as Stretch, scale off this value.
- Kills on Frozen enemies restores 4% of Snow Globe's health and scales with Ability Strength.

Concentrated Arrow:
- With the augment equipped, Artemis Bow fires only one arrow instead of the usual seven.
  - The single arrow has the same stats as an individual arrow without the augment, giving it 240 damage, 25% critical chance, 2.0x critical multiplier, and 20% status chance.
  - Charged shots have +25% base critical chance, increasing the weapon's base crit chance to 50%. This bonus is not affected by power strength.
  - Charging shots will not increase arrow damage, but will increase projectile speed.
  - Arrows are affected by Multishot but not by punch through.
  - Weakpoint hits (including headshots) will add a flat +50% critical chance to the weapon's final critical chance. This bonus is not affected by power strength.
- The explosion deals 500 Blast damage with a 20% status chance and forces an Impact proc.
  - Explosion radius has Line of Sight past 5 meters.
  - Explosion radius is affected by Ability Range and (Primed) Firestorm.
    - Firestorm's bonus is additive to the one from ability range mods.
  - Explosion does not have Damage Falloff.
  - Explosion does gain the +25% base critical chance bonus from charged shots, increasing the base crit chance to 50%.
  - Despite the explosion itself being triggered by a weakpoint hit, the explosion does not gain the +50% flat critical chance on weakpoint hits, as AoE attacks do not count as weakpoint hits / headshots.
  - Explosion is silent and does not inflict self-stagger.
  - Explosion can inflict Slash procs via Hunter Munitions and Internal Bleeding.
    - Damage of Slash procs from Hunter Munitions is not affected by elemental damage mods like Primed Cryo Rounds.
Conseils :
- Synergizes well with Ivara's Sleep Arrow (Quiver), allowing for easy headshots on sleeping targets.
  - Sleeping targets are unable to be staggered by Concentrated Arrow's forced Impact procs.
  - Building for Ability Range allows for both Sleep Arrow and Concentrated Arrow's explosion to hit more targets.
- Also synergizes the bonus critical damage granted by the Empowered Quiver augment.
- Synergizes very well with Longbow Sharpshot as the player will already be aiming for headshots. The bonus damage is applied to both the arrow and the AoE damage.
- Spectral Serration is a powerful alternative to Serration when using Ivara's multiple forms of stealth.
- While Galvanized Scope can apply its critical boost to the AoE damage, the AoE damage will rarely proc the on-kill buff since it only procs on headshot kills. This can make maintaining stacks more difficult when the bow is built around its AoE damage.
- Primary Acuity does not apply to the AoE damage, as AoE damage does not target weakpoints.
- Synergizes with other Warframes with abilities that can pin enemies in place and allow Ivara to easily shoot their heads to proc the explosions (i.e. Trinity's Well of Life, Garuda's Blood Altar, Khora's Ensnare, Harrow's Condemn, Yareli's Sea Snares).
  - Gloom, be it with Sevagoth or infused by Helminth into Ivara herself, will also help slow enemies for easier headshots.
- (Primed) Firestorm is additive to Ability Range: Totaled Explosion Radius = Base Radius × (1 + Ability Range Bonus + Firestorm Bonus)
  - With maxed Stretch and Firestorm, explosion radius will be: 7 × (1 + 0.45 + 0.24) = 11.83 meters.
- Using Concentrated Arrow causes charged shots to only increase projectile speed, rather than altering the shot pattern.
- While the reduction of the number of arrows fired may seem like a handicap, the high explosion damage and radius make Artemis Bow highly viable against crowds.
Conductive Sphere:
- Grants 75% electricity damage and 75% electricity status damage.
  - Electricity damage bonus is additive with electricity damage sources, such as Stormbringer. However, unlike modded electricity damage, this bonus is not counted in the "electricity damage bonuses" portion of the status damage calculation (bug), and therefore does not add any damage to electricity statuses. See Electricity Damage for the status damage formula.
  - Electricity status damage bonus stacks additively with status damage sources, such as Rifle Elementalist. The bonus only applies to electricity procs, but works on both the guaranteed electric procs from this augment and natural electric procs from the weapon.
  - This behavior is after the U38.6 patch, which was supposed to fix the status damage calculation.
- Shooting through multiple arcspheres will grant additional guaranteed electric procs and electricity damage, but will not grant additional electricity status damage.
- Projectiles only need to pass through the Arcsphere's electric field in order to gain the bonus, not the arcsphere object itself.
  - Standing within the electric field will trigger the bonus on all shots fired.
  - Non-projectile (hitscan, beam, etc) weapons can trigger the effect as well, whether by shooting through the sphere or standing within it.
- Visit Buffing Fields to learn more about the mechanic and targets (weapons, abilities, other) which can benefit from this mod.
- Uniquely the added electricity damage is added to some explosive weapons (e.g. acceltra) but the guaranteed electric status is not.
Conductor:
- Recasting costs no additional Energy, and places a Resonator-shaped marker on the ground.
- Once the Ability is recast, the Resonator will stay at the marker for the remaining duration of the Ability.
  - Recasting the Ability a second time will move the Resonator to a new location, provided that marker is not within the radius of the previous one.
- Holding down the Ability button for 1.5 seconds resets the marker, allowing Resonator to move freely once again.
- Can be equipped in the Exilus slot.
- The speed at which Resonator moves to the selected location is affected by Ability Strength. Thus, this means that with a negative Ability Strength, the Resonator can move slower than normal. This can be useful for "herding" groups of enemies to a specific location without moving too fast and getting Resonator out of attraction range.
Contagion Cloud:
- Damage is not affected by melee stealth multipliers. Nothing is affected by any weapon mods.
- Clouds deal Toxin damage without procs, and are therefore not affected by Emerald Archon Shard.
- Clouds are not affected by Toxic Lash and do not pop Spores.
  - The augment will actively make Spores and Combustion Beam worse by stealing their kills.
- Clouds are affected by warframe stats: Ability Range affects radius, Ability Strength damage, and Ability Duration duration.
Conseils :
- The Telos Boltace's suction slide attack works very well with this augment, pulling enemies into a group.
Counter Pulse:
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Unlike Fracturing Crush which offers similar AoE enemy disruption, robotics and gun-wielding enemies will be unable to attack for the stun duration at the cost of having less total duration. Enemies affected by Fracturing Crush can resume using ranged attacks once they recover from the knockdown.
- Affected robotic units are effectively put to sleep, making them vulnerable to stealth multipliers and standing finishers.
Creeping Terrify:
- Speed reduction is affected by Ability Strength.
  - Cannot exceed 80%.
  - Maximum speed reduction is achievable with at least +34% Ability Strength at max rank.
- The mod can be compared to Molecular Prime, as it slows enemies and compensates for its lack of a double damage modifier on affected targets with the ability's removal of enemy armor, making it more effective against armored units.
Conseils :
- This mod encourages players to build their Nekros for range and strength, which already fits well on players who have builds focused on Shadows of the Dead.
Critical Surge:
- Critical chance per meter traveled is affected by Ability Strength.
- Additively stacks with critical chance bonuses such as Point Strike.
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Max critical chance is not affected by mods.
- Energy cost reduction is applied after efficiency mods, is not affected by Ability Strength, and is only applied when used on a Reservoir; if Breach Surge says it costs 20 energy, it'll cost 10.
- Wisp cannot teleport to a pod while within 10 meters of it. Functionally, this means the minimum critical bonus is 100%.
Damage Decoy:
- Has no effect if placing decoy normally, as this augment only affects the new enemy interaction.
- Reflected damage is affected by Ability Strength.
- The enemy will pulse with holographic energy identical to normal Decoy.
- The enemy will still be hostile to the player, and can be injured or killed by players.
  - As such their damage output cannot be buffed by players in any way except for attack speed increases through Rest & Rage or speeding up enemies withMolecular Prime.
- The enemy's health and shields will be increased by 15% of all enemy shields and health within 15 meters of itself when cast, similar to a normal decoy.
  - If shielded enemies are in the area of effect, this will give shields to enemy types that typically do not have shields.
- Because many status effects stun enemies (such as Impact or Heat) the damage reflected is limited and somewhat inconsistent since enemies that are stunned won't attack during their stun animation.
- If an enemy randomly receives Radiation from this effect, it will draw aggro away from the Decoyed enemy, causing nearby enemies to attack the irradiated target instead and stopping them from receiving status or damage redirection from them.
Conseils :
- Mind Control (infused on Loki, or used by Nyx with Decoy infused) can be used on Decoyed enemies, making them invincible from player attacks and allowing the enemy to teleport with the player when they get out of range. This can be used to prevent Decoyed enemies from being easily destroyed.
- Status effects generated via this augment count towards Arcane Impetus.
Dark Propagation:
- Upon killing an enemy afflicted by Sow, the effect will be spread to other enemies within 15m of the killed enemy.
  - The spread Sow debuff uses Sow's currently remaining duration, not a fresh timer.
  - The damage falloff of spread Sow is still calculated based on the enemy's distance to Sevagoth, not the distance to Sow's epicenter.
  - Spread Sow can apply to already Sown enemies, recalculating the ability's damage falloff based on Sevagoth's current distance away.
    - Like normal Sow, spread Sow will only overwrite an existing Sow debuff on an enemy if the new Sow debuff will have a higher duration than the existing one, regardless of whether the new cast potentially has higher ability strength or less damage falloff.
- When casting Death's Harvest via Sevagoth's Shadow, the damage over time effect and duration are determined by the Ability Strength and Ability Duration of the Exalted Shadow, while the spreading range scales solely by the Ability Range on Sevagoth.
Conseils :
- Due to the synergy between Sow and Reap, using Shadow Haze may be advised
Deceptive Bond:
- Damage transfer percentage is affected by Ability Strength. With 200% Strength or more, all damage will be redirected.
- Damage transfer range has a range of 15 meters and is unaffected by Ability Range.
- Whenever damage is being transferred, a tether similar to Link is formed between the Loki and Decoy.
- Damage transferred from Decoy to Loki interacts normally with effects such as Adaptation, Rage or Quick Thinking.
  - With 200% Ability Strength, Decoy can be kept alive under enemy fire for as long as Loki can sustain their own health and shields.
  - Damage reduction abilities can be applied to the Decoy (i.e. Splinter Storm) however it will not double dip with the player's own DR, because damage redirection happens before damage reduction.
- This mod is likely to be detrimental, given that Decoy is designed to attract enemy fire and can generate a health pool larger than the player's.
Desiccation's Curse:
- Maximum Swarm Kavat limit from any source is increased to 5.
- Swarm Kavats have a lifetime of 20s and their Scarab Swarm lingers for 20s.
- Swarm Kavats can only be spawned from enemies opened to finishers via Desiccation itself or when hit by a Swarm Kavat's Scarab Swarm.
- Swarm Kavats are counted as summons and are affected by Summoner's Wrath, Arcane Camisado, and Theorem Infection.
Despoil:
- Desecrate will no longer consume energy, but instead consume health per corpse.
  - Health cost is affected by Ability Efficiency.
- Desecrate will not work if Nekros has insufficient health to drain.
Conseils :
- Nekros' passive ability, Soul Siphon, causes him to regenerate 5 health points per death within a 10m radius, somewhat mitigating the damage from this augment.
- This augment can be used with Equilibrium to recover both energy and health upon pickups of health orbs, which also happens to be a regular drop from Desecrate.
- Does not interrupt Rejuvenation. As a result, its effect will begin immediately after taking damage.
- Melee weapons equipped with Life Strike, Hirudo, Hema or a Furis equipped with Winds of Purity can be used to recover lost health.
- Rage and Quick Thinking do not take effect from Despoil's health drain.
- Health Conversion does not lose a stack from Despoil's health drain.
- Does not activate Arcane Avenger.
Divine Retribution:
- Inflicting a status effect on a speared enemy will spread it to all speared enemies.
  - Triggers on status effects from any source.
  - Spread Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Gas procs ignore elemental mods for their damage calculation.
- Spear retraction removes all Slash, Heat, and Toxin statuses then deals their remaining damage in a burst, multiplied by the status damage multiplier.
  - Effect triggers on both manual and automatic spear retraction.
  - Electricity and Gas will not be removed or benefit from this effect.
- Transferred Electricity status effects trigger Archon Stretch.
  - Transferred Toxin status effects do not trigger Archon Continuity.
  - Transferred Heat status effects do not trigger Archon Vitality.
- Tau status effects can be spread from sources like the Haalvu, weapons affected by a Vomval Trumpet, and Caliban's kit. However, the Venato Prime's passive does not spread Tau status effects, nor does it spread any statuses originating from it, including Sentient Incision. (bug)
- Despite the description mentioning spear explosions, there is no area of effect.
- Enemies who receive spread status effects will not have their status effect damage, duration, or "explosion" increased by Elementalist and Status Duration mods.
  - Faction Damage Mods will only be applied once.
    - However, Faction Damage Bonuses such as Roar will still apply twice.
    - If both a Faction Damage Mod and Roar is used, Roar will apply twice, after which Faction Damage Mods will be applied once to the calculation while being multiplicative with Roar.
      - Therefore, each DoT tick can be calculated to be: Spread DoT = Base Damage * DoT Multiplier * (1 + Faction Damage Bonuses)^2 + Faction Mod Bonuses * (1 + Faction Damage Bonuses).
  - Emerald Archon Shard's "Toxin Status Effects deal +30% (+45%) more damage" will increase the damage of Toxin Status Effects transferred by Divine Retribution as they affect all Toxin Status Effects that originate from the player.
Conseils :
- Weapons that deal incredibly high status effects such as Slash procs can be dealt to a single enemy, which will be transferred to every enemy currently speared for incredible room clearing potential.
  - Alternatively, two Emerald Archon Shards with +2 max corrosive stacks can allow Nezha to fully strip the armor of speared enemies to take advantage of the bonus spear damage.
- Synergizes with a variety of Helminth abilities:
  - Thermal Sunder, Dark Verse, and Null Star with the Neutron Star augment can each hit a large number of speared enemies, transferring each resulting status to all other enemies.
    - Pyrotechnics works similarly, and is currently bugged to hit multiple body parts at the same time on ragdolled enemies (including speared enemies), multiplying its damage output. The ability is also affected by Universal Weapon Bonuses such as Arcane Arachne, allowing for even more damage.
      - Ignis and Ignis Wraith also share the multiple body parts bug that Pyrotechnics has.
  - Abilities such as Larva, Ensnare, and Pull can group up a large number of enemies, which can all be hit at once with an AoE weapon, effectively multiplying the weapon's status output on each enemy.
  - Toxin Elemental Ward combined with the Toxin bonus from Emerald Archon Shards can spread percentage-based health scaling Toxin procs to a large group of enemies.
    - Normally each enemy can only be affected by one Toxin proc from the ability at a time. However, the Toxin procs spread from other enemies with Divine Retribution do not count, allowing for multiple procs to be stacked.
  - Tempest Barrage with the Viral Tempest augment can quickly spread a large number of Corrosive and Viral procs to speared enemies. This can enable the player to build their weapons completely towards damaging statuses, such as Electricity on Quanta Vandal or Heat on Ignis Wraith, without wasting mod slots or status procs on either Corrosive or Viral.
    - Wyrd Scythes can provide a similar effect.
  - Coil Horizon with the Coil Recharge augment can easily output 100s of electric procs on grouped up enemies after the sphere has been charged, dealing an enormous amount of damage to enemies caught in the radius.
  - Marked For Death can spread the status procs from one shot to nearby speared enemies, which will then be spread again to all other speared enemies. For example, if 10 speared enemies are in range of the marked target explosion, a single proc on the marked target will be multiplied into 10 procs on each speared enemy.
  - Sickening Pulse will multiply any existing statuses on enemies, including statuses spread with Divine Retribution.
    - Statuses created by Sickening Pulse will not spread to other speared enemies.
- Enemies affected by Well of Life and Blood Altar cannot be speared, and therefore cannot be used as invincible targets to dump statuses into.
  - However speared enemies can have Well of Life and Blood Altar cast onto them circumventing this restriction.
Dread Ward:
- This augment causes Garuda to become unkillable rather than invulnerable, meaning she will still take damage but her health will not drop to 0 while active.
- Duration is refreshed, not stacked, if the augment is activated again during the effect.
- The duration of the unkillable status is affected by Ability Duration.
- The Dread Ward's effect takes priority over Quick Thinking.
- The augment activates even if the target of Dread Mirror dies before the ability lands.
Duality:
- The duration of the specter is affected by Ability Duration.
- The damage output of the specter is not affected by Ability Strength.
- The specter is an allied NPC that copies the weapon Equinox had equipped before casting Metamorphosis, and uses it to autonomously attack enemies.
  - Only one Duality specter from the player can exist at a time. If Metamorphosis is cast again before the specter's duration expires, the specter will die immediately before a new specter is spawned.
  - The specter is counted as a summon and is affected by Summoner's Wrath, Arcane Camisado, and Theorem Infection.
    - Summoner's Wrath acts as a faction damage bonus, stacking multiplicatively with the damage bonus from Duality and additively with faction damage mods on the specter's equipped weapon.
  - The specter will not use Warframe Abilities.
  - The specter will not swap between different weapons.
  - On weapons with an Alternate Fire mode, only the primary mode will be used.
    - Weapons with multiple modes, like Kuva Hind and Hystrix, will always be used in the mode that they start the mission in, regardless of which mode is being used before casting Metamorphosis.
    - The specter cannot use incarnon modes of weapons. However, the normal mode will benefit from relevant incarnon perks.
  - The specter is considered to be aiming down sights for the purpose of most weapon effects, such as AX-52's passive.
    - Sniper rifles are an exception as they will always be considered to be hip-fired, incurring the hip-fire accuracy penalty on sniper rifles.
  - The specter has slightly reduced accuracy (most obvious on perfectly accurate weapons like Dera Vandal).
  - The specter has its own magazine for ammo, but will deplete the player's ammo reserves upon reloading.
    - However, the specter can reload for a full magazine even if there is 0 ammo reserve left.
    - Since the specter only consumes ammo upon reloading, if it dies before it can finish the reload animation (e.g., Metamorphosis is cast again), no ammo will be consumed from the ammo reserve.
  - The specter will sometimes intentionally collect ammo drops for the player, which restore the player's ammo reserve.
  - The specter has a targeting range of 150 meters; it will not attack enemies further away than this even if it has line of sight to them.
    - Similarly, even if enemies are within this range, if the specter cannot detect them via its senses, the specter can end up in states where it will neither seek nor attack enemies; the specter can even forget about enemies that it has already attacked if it can no longer see them due to terrain.
  - The specter will teleport to the player if it is more than 50 meters away for 5 seconds and not currently in combat.
  - Kills made by the specter contributes to Warframe affinity and has no effect on weapon affinity.
- The specter's health, shields, energy max, and other base stats will mimic Equinox or Equinox Prime's, and can be boosted by mods and other bonuses.
  - Sprint speed is an exception. The specter will always have Equinox's base sprint speed of 1.15, unaffected by sprint speed increases. However, it will be affected by movement speed bonuses such as Arcane Camisado or Speed.
  - The specter also has 200 base armor, rather than Equinox's 135 or Equinox Prime's 160. This is actually due to the 200 armor minimum for non-player units. Armor bonuses like Steel Fiber on the specter will scale with this value rather than Equinox's own armor.
- The specter inherits effects from many different sources on the player's loadout, primarily Mods equipped on Equinox and her weapons, but also some Arcanes, Archon Shards, weapon passives, and Incarnon perks.
  - Permanent / passive stat bonuses will always apply to the specter, such as Arcane Expertise, Serration, and Azure Shard buffs.
  - Permanent unique effects will usually apply to the specter, such as Reflection, Arcane Ice, or Primary Acuity.
  - Temporary bonuses will not be applied to the specter, such as Adaptation, Galvanized Mods, and Primary Merciless. However, any permanent bonuses from these sources will still work on the specter, such as the permanent 80% Multishot on Galvanized Chamber or the 30% Reload Speed on Primary Merciless.
    - The specter can trigger certain temporary bonuses for the player, but the specter itself will not benefit from them, such as Arcane Fury and Arcane Trickery.
  - Conditional effects will sometimes apply to the specter if their buff does not have a limited duration, but instead activates and deactivates when a condition is met. For example, Cascadia Overcharge will take effect any time the specter has overshields, and Hata-Satya will stack up its bonus until the specter reloads.
  - The specter does not inherit any self-only buffs like Xata's Whisper that Equinox had on her before the specter was spawned, nor does the specter copy any self-only buffs that are cast while the specter is active. However, AoE buffs like Roar or Warcry can be applied to the specter by casting them while the specter is active.
- The specter works somewhat differently with melee weapons compared to guns:
  - The specter's 3x damage multiplier does not apply to melee weapons (bug). Instead, it will receive the +700% stealth damage bonus, regardless of enemies being aware of Equinox or the specter itself.
    - As the stealth damage bonus stacks additively with critical damage, critical hits are less valuable for the specter. For example, a weapon with 3x critical damage will deal 8x damage on a stealth attack and 10x on a critical stealth attack.
  - The specter will only perform the neutral combo of whatever stance is equipped on the weapon.
  - The specter does have its own combo counter. It does not copy the player's current combo count when spawned, instead spawning with 0 combo count.
    - Is affected by initial combo, combo count chance, and combo duration bonuses.
    - Combo scaling mods such as Blood Rush and Weeping Wounds do not work on the specter, despite it having a combo count.
  - The specter may perform heavy attacks on low health enemies, specifically when they are within the mercy kill threshold. The heavy attack's damage will scale with the specter's current combo count, and deplete its combo count afterwards.
    - Is affected by heavy attack efficiency and heavy attack wind-up speed bonuses.
    - Cannot trigger Tennokai.
    - Can trigger various unique heavy attack effects from weapons like Syam or Zenistar.
    - Will perform repeated heavy attacks against enemies blinded by certain sources, specifically Radial Blind and Blinding Reave. Other blinds will not trigger this behavior, including Desiccation and Breach Surge.
  - The specter will perform ground finishers on knocked down enemies.
    - Is affected by finisher damage bonuses.
  - The specter will attempt to block incoming attacks from in front of it while approaching enemies.
- Can benefit from the increased critical damage from Cold procs and critical chance from Puncture procs, as it deals weapon damage instead of ability damage.
- If the specter wields a sniper rifle, it will spawn with 0 sniper combo but be able to build up combo by landing shots, taking advantage of the sniper damage multiplier in the process.
- The specter can benefit from the Condition Overload effects of Cedo, Secondary Shiver, Condition Overload, and incarnon perks (such as Burston incarnon's Fatal Affliction). However Galvanized Aptitude, Galvanized Shot, and Galvanized Savvy cannot be triggered by the specter.
  - Guns with additive CO will have the CO damage bonus not be affected by the clone's 3x damage multiplier, giving the CO bonus reduced effectiveness.
    - For example on Cedo, each pellet deals 30 damage normally, so 90 for the clone. With Cedo's innate +60% damage per status, an enemy with 3 statuses should take 90 * (1 + 0.6 * 3) = 90 * 2.8 = 252 damage. Instead, they will only take 90 + 30 * (0.6 * 3) = 90 + 30 * 1.8 = 144 damage. The CO bonus scales with 30 damage rather than 90.
  - Guns with multiplicative CO will behave multiplicatively as expected, with the specter getting the full effectiveness.
  - Condition Overload on melee weapons will correctly apply additively (to normal swings) or multiplicatively (to certain projectiles), getting the full effect in both scenarios.
- If a Gear item such as a Codex Scanner or Archgun Deployer is equipped when Metamorphosis is cast, the specter will spawn with the equipped Primary Weapon, regardless of which weapon was most recently used. If no Primary Weapon is equipped, then the specter will spawn with the equipped Secondary Weapon. If no Primary or Secondary Weapon is equipped, then the specter will spawn with the equipped Melee weapon.
- The specter will gradually take damage if it walks within range of a Nullifier Bubble or a Nul Comba/Scrambus aura.
- Evensong's 7 forced Puncture procs will not be applied from shots fired by the specter.
Conseils :
- The specter is spawned from the casting Equinox at the same time as the mode shift. Using this, it can be dropped into groups of enemies, shed while sliding, etc. In this way, it can be used as a lethal decoy or expendable flanking ally.
- The specter can't cause harm to itself or the casting Equinox using explosive weapons. As a result, it can be effective to equip it with a powerful AoE weapon such as the Kuva Zarr, cast Metamorphosis, and create the clone as a temporary fire support, acting as a decoy when necessary to group enemies.
- The specter spawns with the same Health, Shields, Armor and Energy values as the player character at the start of the mission, or "on spawn." Because of this, combining Primed Flow and Preparation can allow the specter to make great use Primary Overcharge or Quick Thinking.
- Combining Catalyzing Shields for a static 1.33s shield gate with Fast Deflection and Vigilante Vigor for reduced shield recharge delay can allow the specter to consistently survive an occasional shot, regardless of enemy level.
- Primed Sure Footed will make the specter completely immune to knockdowns, improving its survivability and allowing it to output uninterrupted gunfire or melee attacks.
- Summoner's Wrath acts as a 75% faction damage bonus, drastically increasing the specter's damage, especially from status procs.
- Subsumed Well of Life helps the specter in a number of ways, giving it free access to knockdown immunity, status immunity, healing, and a revive if it is killed (with 5 seconds of invincibility afterwards). The specter may target the Well of Life target, wasting the specter's limited lifespan. However, high ability range will allow the specter to benefit from the ability without it being close enough to get distracted by the invincible target.
- Subsumed Quiver can grant consistent stealth to the specter by shooting it with a stealth arrow, increasing its survivability.
  - Empowered Quiver can also grant it status immunity.
  - Arcane Crepuscular synergizes quite well, granting a flat +3.0x critical damage to the specter while invisible.
- Subsumed Radial Blind can blind nearby enemies and cause the specter to repeatedly heavy attack them when equipped with a melee weapon. This works well with strong heavy attack weapons such as Syam.
- Secondary Encumber as well as Emerald Archon Shard (Increase max stacks of Corrosive) fully works on the specter, making a great tool for both priming and armor stripping enemies.
- High fire rate on full auto weapons seems to negatively affect the accuracy of the specter. Utilizing a weapon with a semi-auto or charged Trigger Type may be beneficial to waste less ammo.
Elemental Sandstorm:
- Chance of inflicting status effects is affected by Ability Strength.
- The 50% range bonus is additive to other Ability Range mods, such as Stretch.
- The augment does not work on any enemy which can't be lifted by Sandstorm.
- When triggered, Sandstorm will pick one of the damage types and inflict 1 status proc of the chosen type for every 100% Status Chance.
  - Can only choose and proc 1 damage type on hit, unlike normal sources of Status Chance. For example: an unmodded Dex Nikana with Inaros at 300%Ability Strength will inflict 3 procs of either Impact / Slash / Puncture in the same trigger. Eventually procs of all types will be inflicted with enough triggers.
Elusive Retribution:
- Buff stack cap is unaffected by mods.
- Attack Speed and Critical Damage bonuses are affected by Ability Strength.
- Buff duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
Empowered Quiver:
- Critical multiplier bonus and status effect resistance chance are affected by Ability Strength.
  - Bonus values are snapshot at cast time, allowing for significantly empowered permanent critical multiplier buffs in combination with temporary strength increases, similar to Reservoirs
- The critical multiplier bonus stacks additively with critical damage mods.
  - For example, combining Empowered Quiver with a maxed Vital Sense will increase a rifle's critical multiplier by 220%.
Conseils :
- Synergizes well with Prowl as Ivara gains additional damage on headshots, and crits will be multiplied further by this mod.
  - Similarly, the augment synergizes well with Piercing Navigator and/or Concentrated Arrow due the the critical chance bonuses granted by both augments.
Endless Lullaby:
- There is a 3-second cooldown between Lull re-triggers, whether by initiating a finisher on or killing a sleeping enemy.
- Lull fields are generated at the location of the player.
- Re-triggered fields persist for the normal duration of the ability (e.g., 5 seconds at 100% power duration).
  - Multiple fields can exist simultaneously if one is triggered before older fields expire.
- The Passive: +50% Lull Duration refers to the base duration of the ability and will therefore always extend the modded duration of the initial Lull by 10 seconds.
  - The duration increase refers only to the sleep duration of the ability, not the field duration.
- The term remaining duration refers to the remaining time for which the triggering enemy would have slept.
  - Because there is a delay between when an enemy is first affected by a Lull field and when it falls asleep and the sleep timer starts decreasing, enemies slept by a re-triggered field will wake up later than enemies slept by the original field.
  - If the remaining sleep duration of a re-triggered field is short enough, and the field duration long enough, enemies can be 'chain slept', falling asleep and waking up repeatedly until the field expires.
Enduring Bastille:
- Enemies killed inside Bastille extends the active duration of Bastille by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 2x the ability's duration after mods.
- Throwing a Vortex into a Vortex extends the active duration of Vortex up by 70% of its maximum duration, up to a maximum of 10x the ability's duration after mods.
Energy Transfer:
Conseils :
- Players can use Metamorphosis to switch back and forth to reapply Maim's Slash damage, bleed proc, and stun on enemies that have already been hit before.
- Like all channeled abilities, the Ability Strength will stay the same for the duration of the channeling even after using Metamorphosis.
  - It is possible to have Mend benefit from Provoke's Ability Strength increase.
Enraged:
- Cooldown starts after the duration ends, and cannot start while Transferenced out.
- Cooldown is equal to the length of time Hysteria was active. For example, if Hysteria was activated for 5 seconds, the cooldown will be 5 seconds.
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Bonus damage and critical chance are not affected by mods and stack additively with mods like Pressure Point and True Steel.
- Cannot be equipped at the same time as Hysterical Assault.
- Recurring bug, where critical bonus mods stack in the simulacrum but not in game.
Enveloping Cloud:
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
- Duration cannot be refreshed. However, allies within the cloud's radius will have their timers paused.
- The following characters are affected by Enveloping Cloud:
  - Ally players
  - Atlas' Rumblers
  - Wukong's Companions
  - Celestial Twin
  - Warframe Specters
  - Rescue hostage
- The following characters are not affected by Enveloping Cloud:
  - Wukong himself
  - Ally syndicate operatives, including Arbitration Defense operatives
  - Syndicate Spectres
  - Clem
  - Kavor Defectors
Escape Velocity:
- Movement speed boost is not affected by Ability Strength.
  - Stacks with Speed and affects archwing.
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Speed boost duration is refreshed when affected players teleport through an active Wormhole again.
- Despite Escape Velocity's description that it affects allies, it will only apply its speed effect to Warframes and not to allies such as Specters, invasion allies, or allies created with abilities such as Loki's Decoy.
- Unlike most other Augment mods, Escape Velocity is also classified as an Exilus mod, and thus can be inserted into a Warframe's Exilus slot.
Eternal War:
- The duration increase per enemy killed is affected by Ability Duration.
- Kills extend the active duration of Warcry up to a maximum of double the ability's duration after mods.
- Kills also extend Warcry's duration for allies.
  - Only melee kills made by the caster will extend the duration.
  - Kills with Hysterical Assault's leap do not count as melee kills.
- Warcry will persist on allies as long as it persists on Valkyr. This means allies can enter Nullifier Crewman bubbles and fall off the map without losing the buff, but if Valkyr does either of those, everyone will lose the buff.
Conseils :
- One can cast Warcry on their squad at the beginning of a mission, which can then be maintained for the entire mission with Eternal War by rapidly melee-killing enemies, allowing the team to benefit from Warcry while keeping energy expenditure low. This is easiest to do in endless mode missions like Survival, Defense, and Interception. Care should be taken around Nullifier Crewmen and tilesets where one can easily fall off the map, as either will end Warcry prematurely.
Everlasting Ward:
- There is a bug with Elemental Ward that makes this mod mandatory for anyone with a heat Chroma. The bug occurs when allies gain the buff, they leave the radius, then return to the radius during the same casting of Elemental Ward. Even if allies have taken no damage, upon returning they will keep their normal health and have a huge chunk of empty space where Medi-Ray and other healing sources will attempt to heal, which are wasted in the end.
  - For example: an ally with 740 health has their health increased to 1000 by a nearby Chroma. They leave, then come back into the radius and now have 740/1000 health, causing Medi-Ray and Curative Undertow to heal the player, wasting the ability or energy respectively.
  - This is not related to the nerf to Elemental Ward that used to allow players who entered the radius to become fully healed each time, this bug occurred after this nerf occurred. What is supposed to happen, is the ally will only heal once, but still gain the extra health each time they enter the radius.
Exothermic: - The drop rates of Energy Orbs from the Exothermic Mod are not affected by Ability Strength.
Explosive Legerdemain:
- Damage is affected by Ability Strength, whereas status chance is not.
  - Explosion has 100% damage falloff over its radius.
- Pickup conversion range and explosion radius are affected by Ability Range.
  - Pickup conversion range is same as Sleight of Hand trap radius.
- Duration of 60 seconds is not affected by Ability Duration.
  - Duration is paused when it attracts enemies.
- Converts Ammo Pickups, Affinity Orbs, Energy Orbs, and Health Orbs into proximity mines that dealCold, Toxin,Electricity, andHeat damage respectively.
  - Universal Orbs will be destroyed without creating any type of proximity mines.
- Affected pickups are destroyed in the process and cannot be picked up by Mirage. Ally players' client-side pickups are unaffected.
- Proximity mines will detonate when an enemy steps on the mine or when the mine's duration expires.
Conseils :
- This augment mod synergizes extremely well with the Archon mod set, as each proximity trap can proc the four base elemental damage that will trigger four of the five mods' special effects.
- This mod may be used for crowd control in missions with tight paths and corridors.
- Works very well in Sanctuary Onslaught due to the large amount of enemies.
Fireball Frenzy:
- Damage bonus is affected by Ability Strength.
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
- Adds Heat damage to weapons. This damage bonus does not combine with other elements, but does contribute to DoT, and is additive with elemental mods.
  - Does not affect Exalted Weapons or Warframe abilities.
- Multiple Fireball Frenzy do not stack; the buff with the highest Ability Strength will take effect.
  - However if a weaker with more Ability Duration is cast, it will take effect after the stronger buff expires.
Fracturing Crush:
- Immobilize duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Armor reduction is affected by Ability Strength, fully removing armor at 134% Ability Strength. Using Corrosive Projection will allow a full strip at 110% Ability Strength.
- Immobilized enemies are unable to move and forced to stand still, but are still able to look around and attack.
- Recasting Crush refreshes the immobilize duration.
Freeze Force:
- Damage bonus is affected by Ability Strength.
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
- Adds Cold damage to weapons. This damage bonus does not combine with other elements, and is additive with elemental mods.
  - Does not affect Exalted Weapons or Warframe Abilities.
- Multiple Freeze Forces do not stack; the buff with the highest Ability Strength will take effect.
  - However, if a weaker buff with a longer Ability Duration is cast, it will take effect after the stronger buff expires.
Funnel Clouds:
- Funnel Clouds adds additional tornadoes, yielding a total of 11 tornadoes per cast at max rank. All tornadoes summoned are only 50% of their regular size.
- Wandering Tornadoes can still be guided by the player.
- Tornadoes will move faster than their non-augmented counterparts.
- All tornadoes are summoned regardless of the number of nearby enemies.
- Tornadoes deal as much damage as full-sized tornadoes, just to fewer enemies due to their size.
- Tornadoes will no longer innately lift enemies off the ground and trap them.
  - Enemies in a ragdolled state, such as those affected by Airburst, will then be picked up and trapped by tornadoes.
- Tornadoes will patrol randomly in all directions and move toward enemies in range.
Conseils :
- Funnel Clouds is well-suited to a strength and duration based Zephyr build, as the tornadoes can dish out massive amounts of damage without help from players' weapons.
Furious Javelin:
- A rippling aura will appear under Excalibur when the melee damage buff is active. This aura will become brighter with every cast of Radial Javelin.
- Duration of melee damage buff is affected by Ability Duration.
- The bonus melee damage is affected by Ability Strength.
- Melee Damage bonus stacks multiplicatively with other sources of Melee Damage.
  - For example, with a maxed Pressure Point and Intensify equipped, 5 enemies hit, and a weapon that deals 100 damage, the modified damage will be: Base Damage × (1 + Damage Mods) × (1 + Furious Javelin Bonus × (1 + Ability Strength) × #Enemies Hit) = 100 × (1 + 1.2) × (1 + 0.15 × (1 + 0.3) × 5) = 434.5
  - Melee damage and elemental damage mods are both equally affected.
  - Does not multiply with Condition Overload's bonus when additive.
    - See Condition Overload (Mechanic) for further details.
- Recasts refresh the duration, but override the previous bonus, regardless of whether it was higher or lower.
- The damage bonus applies to Exalted Blade and its waves as well.
Fused Crucible:
- Qorvex is completely Invulnerable while channeling Fused Crucible.
- Qorvex can move at 50% Movement Speed and can only perform the Rolling maneuver at 40% reduced speed while channeling Fused Crucible.
  - Parkour velocity mods and shards affect the rolling maneuver.
- Energy drain and energy ramp up drain are both affected by Ability Efficiency and Ability Duration.
  - Recasting the ability will reset the energy ramp-up.
  - While not reflected in associated tool tips, Ability Duration will impact how quickly it drains energy, in line with other channeled abilities.
- Fused Crucible will end if Qorvex runs out of energy, or if deactivated by pressing the ability key again (default 4 ).
  - Qorvex cannot replenish energy using Energy Vampire, Rally Point, Rift Plane's innate energy regeneration, Squad Energy Restores, Energy Siphon, Energy Nexus, Dreamer's Bond, Wellspring, Rage, and/or Hunter Adrenaline while Fused Crucible is active.
  - Fused Crucible's energy drain is not converted into shields by Augur Mods.
  - Energy can be replenished by Energy Orbs, Orokin Void Death Orb's energy restores, Equilibrium, Spellbound Harvest, Arcane Energize, and Emergence Dissipate's Energy Motes while the ability is active.
Conseils :
- Due to the high spreading of Radiation status effects, Arcane Universal Fallout can generate a consistent number of universal orbs to sustain the ability.
- As Containment Wall cannot be cast during the ability, thus losing access to Wrecking Wall, it is recommended to subsume abilities such as Ophanim Eyes over it to provide some means of defense stripping without needing to recast.
Fused Reservoir:
- Energy cost is not affected by mods.
- Fused Reservoir counts as 3 summoned Reservoirs and Wisp is still limited to 6 total Reservoirs at once, meaning only 2 of the combined versions can be used at any given time.
- Doubles the energy cost of using the combined version, rather than tripling it, saving 25 base energy when using the combined version.
- The combined version has all three motes, regardless of whether Wisp is of a high enough level to have them.
- Missions will start with the Fused Reservoir automatically selected.
Conseils :
- Useful for Empowered builds, requiring only one instance of Empower to charge all three versions at once, saving energy.
- Because it simply adds another type of Reservoir and does not remove the normal ones, the player can still mix and match to place more motes in more locations if necessary (such as Defection), keeping in mind the 6 max Reservoirs still applies.
- The mod can left unraked if one does not mind to pay the same energy price as it would for the 3 Pods, while getting 3 (or 2 in case of a matching polarity) extra mod capacity.
Gaseous Quake:
- Gaseous Quake changes Sound Quake into a Channeled Ability. While channeling, Banshee is invulnerable and unable to perform any other actions, including moving.
- Functions very similarly to Sound Quake, creating a 12 / 15 / 18 / 20 meter area around the point of cast.
  - Requires line of sight to the target, unlike Sound Quake.
    - LoS requirement does not apply to Objects.
- Enemies within the zone initially take 125 / 150 / 175 / 200 Gas damage per second, suffering Stagger and 1 - 5 Gas procs per hit (scaling with distance from the ability's center).
  - Number of Gas procs per hit diminishes as enemies get further from the zone's center, applying 5 procs per hit within roughly the first 20% of the ability's max range, 4 per hit within 20% - 40% of the range, etc. down to 1 per hit at 80% - 100% of the range.
  - Once 10 Gas procs have been reached on an enemy, any further procs will overwrite the oldest procs, allowing them to be replaced with new procs with a higher damage multiplier.
  - Gaseous Quake's damage pulses cannot hit Sonar weakpoints, but the resulting Gas Clouds can.
- Current damage per second is multiplied by 2.75x for each second the ability is channeled.
  - This multiplier stacks multiplicatively with itself each second, up to a cap of 24,736x after 10 seconds of channeling. This gives the ability a maximum base damage of 4,947,171 per second (not including Gas procs).
  - Does not require line of sight to any targets in order to scale the damage.
  - Despite releasing one pulse per second and the damage multiplier also being increased once per second, the timing of the two are slightly offset from each other. Because of this, the damage multiplier may increase while the pulse is traveling, causing enemies further away from Banshee to receive 2.75x more damage than enemies close to her, up until the multiplier cap is reached.
- The augment increases the initial energy cost to 100 Energy, then drains 16 Energy per second while channeling, affected by Ability Duration and Efficiency.
  - Current energy drain per second is multiplied by 1.2x for each second the ability is channeled.
    - The drain multiplier stacks with itself multiplicatively each second, however unlike the damage multiplier it has no cap, eventually making the ability impossibly expensive to continue channeling regardless of your energy economy.
- The zone remains for ? / ? / ? / 6.25 seconds after Banshee stops channeling, continuing to deal damage in the area every second.
  - Maintains the final damage multiplier that was reached during channeling.
Conseils :
- To reach the maximum damage multiplier, it costs 100 Energy for the initial cast plus approximately 514 Energy to channel for 10 seconds, for a total of 614 Energy.
  - Primed Flow brings Banshee to 641 energy and Banshee Prime to 755, giving them just enough energy to reach the max multiplier even without Ability Duration or Efficiency mods to reduce the cost.
Gastro:
- Regurgitated enemies bounce up to 3 times, exploding in a 6 meter AoE and leaving a 6 meter gas cloud on each bounce.
  - Explosions and gas clouds do not require Line of Sight to damage enemies.
- The bounce explosions deal the same damage as Regurgitate normally does (2000 + 10% of Regurgitated enemy's current HP), but dealt as Gas damage instead of Toxin damage. Each explosion also procs 2 guaranteed Gas statuses, with the final explosion additionally proccing 1 Toxin status.
  - Each explosion deals 75% less damage than the last, dealing 100% of the expected damage on the first explosion, 25% on the second, and 6.25% on the last.
  - Explosion damage has no radial falloff, dealing full damage even at the edge of its range.
  - Proc damage scales with the damage of the explosion that caused them, dealing 50% of that damage per second for 6 seconds.
- Like Regurgitate, each explosion permanently strips 75% armor from any enemies hit.
  - Armor is stripped before damage is dealt.
  - Stacks with each bounce for a maximum of 225% armor strip after 3 bounces, allowing for a full armor strip with as low as 45% ability strength.
- Gas clouds remain for 8 seconds and inflict 250 Gas damage per second with a guaranteed Gas proc on every hit.
  - Gas clouds are not affected by the 75% damage falloff per bounce and will always deal the full 250 damage per second.
  - Gas procs from the clouds have 50% reduced duration, only lasting for 3 seconds and dealing 3 ticks of 125 damage before expiring.
Gastroparesis:
- The augment adds an Extra Hit (whose damage type is purely Gas) to Grendel's Primary and Secondary weapons.
  - The augment does not give any Gas elemental damage.
- The extra hit deals 15% - 75% of the initial hit's damage, based on the number of enemies currently in Grendel's stomach.
  - Every pellet from Multishot will trigger its own individual extra hit.
  - Extra hit damage scales with the weapon's final damage per pellet, including bonuses to base damage, elemental damage, critical hits, and faction damage.
    - Extra hits themselves cannot crit, but will have their damage appropriately increased if the triggering hit is a crit.
    - The extra hit double dips on faction damage bonuses.
- Each extra hit deals a forced Gas status effect.
  - The forced proc triple dips on faction damage bonuses.
  - Is affected by status damage and status duration bonuses.
  - Pure Gas elemental bonuses, such as from Leaded Gas or spliced rivens, will increase the damage of the Gas proc. Heat and toxin elemental bonuses will not have any effect.
- Archguns, Melees, and Incarnon forms do NOT benefit from this augment.
Conseils :
- Abilities like Roar, Damage Vulnerability abilities like Molecular Prime, & Status Effects like Heat, Electricity, Toxin, Blast, & Gas will make enemies eaten from Feast take increased damage while inside Grendel's Gut, making the buff harder to keep up.
Gourmand:
- Health drain on cast is affected by Ability Efficiency.
- Armor bonus is not affected by mods.
- At max rank, the armor bonus increases Grendel's passive armor bonus to 400 per enemy and the total armor bonus to 2,000 at the 5 enemy cap.
Greedy Pull:
- Pulls all pickups within a radius approximately equal to Pull's range toward Mag.
  - Pickup pull radius is affected by Ability Range.
  - Pickup travel distance per cast is affected by Ability Strength.
  - Mission items such as Datamasses and Power Cells are unaffected.
- Line of sight is required to pull pickups.
- Pickups are only pulled for the player casting it. Pickups for other players in the squad will remain in their original positions.
Guardian Armor:
- Duration is capped at current modded Vex Armor duration.
- Kills made by Chroma will trigger the duration increase and healing.
  - However, kills made by Chroma's companions will not.
- Heal is 5% of max health over 3 seconds, which is 1.67% per second.
- Additional kills while the heal over time is active will refresh it; additional kills do not stack the heal over time.
- Damage reduction does not apply to Chroma; only squadmates benefit from it.
- Despite specifying squadmates, it does apply to defense objectives as well.
- Guardian armor can activate Archon Intensify, provided that Health is actually restored, which demands that the player first take damage.
  - Restoring Health of ally Warframes or Companions will also grant the bonus.
Guided Effigy:
- While Effigy is active, hold 4 while aiming at a valid location to mark Effigy's destination with a beacon for no energy cost.
  - If a beacon is already placed, holding 4 again will move the beacon to the new location.
- Once a beacon is created, Effigy will take flight at high speed toward the beacon, occasionally leaping great heights and distances if there is terrain elevation difference or teleporting to the beacon if unable to reach by normal means.
