- Damage is affected by Ability Strength.
- The flight's damage is not affected by Summoner's Wrath, Theorem Infection, and Vex Armor.
- The flight's damage does not contribute to Arcane Camisado. However, its movement speed is affected.
- Energy refund per enemy is inversely affected by Ability Efficiency.
- Upon arrival, Effigy's roar cooldown is reset, allowing it roar and stun enemies if they are in range or bash away enemies in melee range.
Hallowed Eruption:
- Hallowed Eruption's damage is given by Hallowed Ground's damage multiplied by its remaining duration, so it is affected by both Ability Strength and Ability Duration. For example:
  - Without further modding, its maximum damage is [20⋅2⋅(1+2)]⋅100=12,000 .
  - With Intensify, its maximum damage becomes [20⋅2⋅(1+2)]⋅[100⋅(1+0.3)]=15,600 .
  - With Continuity, its maximum damage becomes [20⋅2⋅(1+2+0.3)]⋅100=13,200 .
- The detonation applies 1 Radiation Status Effect.
- The detonation area is a sphere centered on the point where Hallowed Ground was created, inheriting the Hallowed Ground's radius. It is able to hit enemies that are not affected by Hallowed Ground, as long as they are in Hallowed Eruption's area.
  - The detonation is not affected by line of sight.
- Detonating Hallowed Ground has no cast animation or Energy cost.
- With this Augment, only one patch of Hallowed Ground can be active at a time.
- Hallowed Reckoning's fields are not considered to be Hallowed Ground, so they are not affected by Hallowed Eruption.
Hallowed Reckoning:
- The zones deal 300 Radiation damage per second, increased by 50 per radiation stack on the damaged enemy.
  - Damage applies 1 forced Radiation proc per hit.
    - This technically affects Arbitration Shield Drones and will trigger Arcane Universal Fallout on them.
  - The zones deal a flat 50 extra damage per radiation stack, despite the UI showing it as 30 scaling with ability strength (bug).
- Synergizes with grouping abilities (e.g. Larva) to generate multiple overlapping zones, rapidly damaging enemies.
- This mod does not interact with Hallowed Eruption:
  - The small Hallowed Ground patches created by Hallowed Reckoning cannot be detonated.
  - The small patches do not count toward Hallowed Eruption's one-patch limit; they neither remove nor are removed by the main Hallowed Ground patch.
  - The small patches do not receive Hallowed Eruption's duration bonus.
- Recasting Reckoning will not remove previously created damage zones.
- Damage zones do not inherit effects of Reckoning, new enemies walking into zones will not lose armor or drop more Health Orbs.
Healing Flame:
- Heal amount is affected by Ability Strength.
- Overguard granted by Healing Flame has a cap of 10,000, affected by Ability Strength.
- When using with subsumed Fire Blast, Healing Flame will heal equal to 50% of Ember's heat level: 37 health. Overguard will also not be generated.
- Immolation does not have to be active for the ability to grant overguard, however it will always be at the minimum amount.
Hearty Nourishment:
- Duration per enemy is affected by Ability Duration.
- As Warframes other than Grendel are unable to Feast to have enemies in their stomachs, neither the removal of Status Effects nor the status immunity are applied, rendering this augment useless on Warframes infused with Nourish.
- Prevents blocking while active.
Hushed Invisibility:
- When doing a Stealth mission, enemies still need to be killed in a short time period, otherwise they will become alerted and alert all nearby enemies.
  - Surviving enemies will also blindly fire at the point of origin of the attack, posing risk for Loki.
- This augment will not be active if Loki becomes invisible by other means, e.g. Untraceable, Arcane Trickery, or etc.
Hysterical Assault:
- Leap distance is affected by Ability Range.
- Leaping requires the reticle to be aimed near an enemy.
- Cannot be equipped at the same time as Enraged.
- The added invulnerability can allow Valkyr to briefly fire another weapon and switch back to melee without ever losing invulnerability.
- Can be cast during any melee attack to cancel it, or slam attack to slightly redirect the impact.
- Can be cast during abilities like Rip-Line, and potentially other non full body animations.
- The contact damage can not crit, but otherwise acts as a single attack from Valkyr Talons.
Ice Wave Impedance:
- Cold Status per second is not affected by mods.
- Trail duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Multiple frozen trails can be active at once, limited only by the duration of each trail.
- Allied players are unaffected by the trail.
- Nullifier Crewman will destroy any cold area that their bubbles touch.
- The trail will not apply any Cold status effects to the enemies with overguard.
- The trail will apply maximum of 6Cold status effects to the enemies on the trail (combining to 10 with the initial cast of the ability)
- The trail does not count as part of the Ice Wave ability and will not freeze enemies for the enhanced duration of Ice Wave freeze. Instead on reaching 10Cold status effects the standard Frozen duration of 3 seconds will be applied.
Conseils :
- Works extremely well against melee-focused enemies such as most Infested, slowing entire mobs of enemies and making it easier to kill them.
  - Infested can be even further slowed by the player and squad members equipping Infested Impedance.
  - This augment synergizes very well with Loki's Radial Disarm, forcing enemy units to use melee attacks and thus become more susceptible to the augment's effects.
Icy Avalanche:
- Overguard granted by Icy Avalanche has a cap of 15,000.
- Overguard per enemy is calculated before Frost's Passive, Fortifying Freeze, is applied.
- Overguard from armor granted per enemy is only gained once per enemy. Subsequent casts on the same enemy will not grant the armor portion of Overguard. Because of this, Fortifying Freeze will only benefit Overguard generation if new enemies are frozen while the armor persists from the previous cast.
- Enemies still frozen by a previous casting of Avalanche will still grant the 60 Overguard per enemy hit on subsequent casts.
- The equation for Overguard is: (60 × Ability Strength × Enemies affected by Avalanche) + (Armor × 20% × Ability Strength × Enemies affected by Avalanche)
- For example with 130% Ability Strength, 500 Armor and 10 enemies the equation becomes: (60 × 1.3 × 10) + (500 × 0.2 × 1.3 × 10) = 2,080
- On repeat casts against enemies who have been hit by Avalanche before it becomes: (60 × Ability Strength × Enemies affected by Avalanche)
- For example with 130% Ability Strength, 500 Armor and 10 enemies who have already been affected by Avalanche the equation becomes: (60 × 1.3 × 10) = 780
Conseils :
- Ivara's Noise Arrow, Vauban's Bastille vortex and similar abilities that attract enemies to a single location synergize well with Icy Avalanche, as they can be used to group enemies closer together allowing for a larger number of enemies to be hit by Avalanche.
Immolated Radiance:
- As Immolation's Damage Reduction has a maximum value of 90%, the Damage Reduction shared via this augment is capped at 45%.
- This mod only affects other Warframes.
Infernum:
- While flying with Infernalis, Uriel releases 4 fireballs per second which home onto targets in Line of Sight within 50 meters. Fireballs deal 1500 Heat direct hit damage, plus an additional 1500 Heat AoE damage in a 5 meter radius with a forced Heat proc.
  - The AoE damage has 100% damage falloff over its radius.
  - If there are no targets, fireballs will shoot in the direction of the aiming reticle with a ~45° spread to either side.
  - The fireballs will not target Nullifier Crewman-type enemies.
    - You can fly at the ground near a nullifier to aim the fireballs and damage the globe with explosions.
    - If another enemy is under a nullifier globe, the fireballs will target it, swirl around the orb unable to penetrate it, then eventually explode and damage the globe.
- Picking up a rune from Demonium will increase Uriel's output to 12 fireballs per second for 5 seconds.
  - The rune does not need to be collected during flight to trigger the effect, despite the mod description. It may be picked up on the ground and the bonus will apply during any time Uriel is in flight over the next 5 seconds.
  - Recasting Infernalis during the buff will prematurely reset the fireball rate back to normal.
  - Duration is calculated at the time of pickup, allowing the use of Arcane Concentration.
- Fireball direct hit and AoE damage are both affected by Universal Weapon Bonuses such as Arcane Avenger, Arcane Arachne, and Nourish.
  - Fireballs have 0% critical chance and 1.0x critical damage, requiring additive bonuses in order to gain any effect.
  - Both the direct hit and AoE damage have 0% status chance (although the AoE has a forced heat proc), so Nourish will only increase the direct hit and AoE damage. It will not allow for Viral procs nor will it increase the resulting heat status damage.
    - For example, at 100% ability strength a subsumed Nourish will increase the total damage of a single fireball from 6750 damage (1500 direct hit + 1500 AoE + [5s * 750 heat status damage per tick] = 6750) to 8100 damage (1.45 Nourish damage multiplier * [1500 direct hit + 1500 AoE] + [5s * 750 heat status damage per tick] = 8100).
  - Even though Uriel can swap weapons during flight, he will only equip the weapon upon landing or when interrupting the flight with an aim glide. Vigorous Swap consequently cannot be refreshed during flight.
  - Using flat critical chance buffs like Arcane Avenger, the fireballs may trigger Arcane Acceleration, Arcane Fury, Arcane Momentum, Arcane Tempo, and Arcane Velocity.
- Each fireball direct hit grants 1% Brimstone charge.
- The duration of the fireball buff when picking up runes is still affected by Uriel's modded Ability Duration even if Demonium has been replaced via Helminth, despite the rune's weapon buff being locked to 100% duration in this case.
- Uriel's Infernalis flight speed does not affect the cast rate of fireballs.
- Fireballs can hit weak points, allowing them to activate arcanes such as Arcane Consequence, Arcane Precision, and Arcane Rage.
  - The parkour velocity from Arcane Consequence will not be applied during flight however, requiring the flight to be stopped then restarted to gain the bonus.
  - "On headshot kill" and "on weakpoint kill" conditions cannot be triggered by the fireballs.
Conseils :
- For quick completion of low level missions, combine Arcane Arachne and Proton Pulse to gain a large fireball damage boost and massive Infernalis flight speed boost, both from a simple wall latch + wall dash maneuver.
  - Conversely, if one desires more Brimstone charge it is worth considering removing sources of parkour velocity so that more fireballs will be launched towards groups Uriel passes by.
- Archon Vitality can be used to increase the number of heat procs to two per fireball.
- If one intends to spend an extensive time flying, it is advisable to avoid free-roam companions such as Kubrows, Kavats, Predasites, or Vulpaphylas as they will spend much of their time attempting to catch up, unlike a sentinel.
  - Furthermore, usage of aerial mods such as Agility Drift, Aerial Bond, Aviator, Aerodynamic and so forth may be advisable in these conditions.
    - Note that kills from fireballs will not count for Aerial Bond's recovery timer reduction but the cold aura works and accumulates properly.
- Sacred Annihilation from The Descendia applies to the fireballs, allowing them to potentially instant kill targets with each hit.
- The runes from other Uriel's Demonium will also trigger the increased fireball rate.
Infiltrate:
- When Prowl is active with Infiltrate equipped, Ivara will not be affected by Laser Barriers, Sensor Bars, Laser Plates, or Cutting Lasers. Bypassing them will not set off any connected Spy, Rescue, or Reactor Sabotage security alarms.
  - The effects of Infiltrate do not apply during the casting animation for Prowl, but only after the animation is completed.
  - In the Earth Grineer Forest Vault with the downward tunnel and elevator ramp over water, the Motion Detector will still trigger the alarms if Ivara touches it, however it will not damage her. It cannot be destroyed and thus it is recommended to take an alternate route.
    - This is most likely a bug.
  - Lasers in Infested Ship Rescue will still trigger alarms on contact.
- Speed bonus is affected by Ability Strength.
  - With 400% Ability Strength, Prowl's movement speed penalty is negated. Strength above 400% will increase Ivara's movement speed beyond normal.
  - While on ziplines, including Dashwire Arrows, Prowl's movement speed penalty doesn't apply but Infiltrate's speed bonus does, causing Ivara to run much faster on ziplines.
Insatiable:
- Bonus Mutation stack chance is affected by Ability Strength.
  - Stack chance can increase over 100%, giving Nidus additional chances to receive multiple stacks. For example, 150% chance guarantees 1 additional stack and a 50% chance to generate a second stack.
- Stacks gained from enemies outside of Ravenous' radius can generate bonus Mutation stacks as long as Nidus stands on the spawning grounds.
- Mutation stacks gained from Maggot explosions at the end of Ravenous' duration can generate bonus Mutation stacks.
Conseils :
- The augment enables players to collect Mutation stacks at a much higher rate.
- Using a high range Larva lets players deal with faraway enemies easily while staying on the spawning grounds.
- Casting Parasitic Link on an ally can significantly boost the stack gain.
Intrepid Stand:
- Overguard amount is affected by Ability Strength.
- Overguard granted by Intrepid Stand has a cap of 15,000, affected by Ability Strength.
- Only ally Warframes and Companions can receive Overguard. It does not benefit Specters, Defense Objects, or other allied NPCs.
- The augment will grant Overguard per enemy hit, that includes invulnerable enemies that can take hits (e.g. Arbitration Shield Drone).
- As Overguard has a 0.5 second "gating" before shields are damaged, this gives Styanax synergy with his Rally Point, allowing him to regain shields for a full shield gate the next time they are depleted.
  - Functionally, this allows Styanax (and nearby allies with shields) to potentially have 1.8 seconds of protection before health is damaged.
Intruder:
Conseils :
- Helpful for the Terminal Hacking Mastery Test at Rank 5.
- This is very useful for Sorties or Nightmare Mode missions as the use of Ciphers are disabled.
Iron Shrapnel:
- 8 meter detonation range is affected by Ability Range.
  - Affects enemies behind walls and cover.
- Deals a percentage of remaining Iron Skin Overguard as Puncture damage.
  - Damage has 100% falloff over its radius.
- Radial explosion inflicts Knockdown against enemies, flinging them away and making them vulnerable to Ground Finishers.
- Roar affects Iron Shrapnel's damage.
- The detonation does not occur if Iron Skin depletes naturally due to enemy fire.
- Cannot be cast during Iron Skin's invulnerability period.
- Detonating Iron Skin does not cost energy.
Ironclad Charge:
- Each enemy and Shadows of the Dead hit by Rhino Charge increases Rhino's total armor value.
- Armor bonus is affected by Ability Strength.
- Armor bonus duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- When an armor buff is already applied, charging a second time and receiving another bonus will cancel the first bonus.
Conseils :
- The mentioned "Armor Rating" is a final multiplier to your total armor value after mods, arcanes, and abilities such as Parasitic Armor.
  - Example: A Steel Fiber (+100% armor) on Rhino Prime will net you 580 total armor. Hitting 2 enemies with Rhino Charge and the Ironclad Charge augment equipped will result in +100% Armor Rating for a total of 1160 armor.
- Due to the fact that Iron Skin scales with armor, this can be used to great effect by charging at several enemies, then applying Iron Skin to take advantage of the armor buff. This can result in a much stronger Iron Skin.
- Charging with a large bonus is not suggested, due to the likelihood that the bonus will be replaced by a smaller one.
Ironclad Flight:
- This mod does not disable Titania's innate passive of healing herself and allies after casting an ability.
- Practically identical to Aviator, but with a different polarity and added "bonus". Cannot be equipped at the same time as that mod.
- Can be used with Agility Drift to grant a 47.2% damage reduction while airborne. In addition, can be used with Agility Drift and Aerodynamic to grant 59.872% damage reduction while airborne.
- Can be used in conjunction with rolling in the air for an even greater damage reduction.
Irradiating Disarm:
- Enemies hit by Radial Disarm are affected by Confusion status, not Radiation procs.
- Although Radial Disarm can be re-cast at any time to disarm and apply Confusion to additional enemies, the duration cannot be extended or renewed on enemies who already have the effect on them. The effect must run out completely before they can be confused again.
- Does not affect enemies with Overguard, because it has to disarm first.
- Enemies that are already running to an objective (e.g. cryopod, terminal, etc.) will sometimes continue to run to the location before turning and attacking eachother.
- Affected enemies tend to ignore unaffected enemies, and clump together in melee groups.
Jade's Judgment:
- Gives each damage tick from a Light's Judgment well a 5% chance of spawning a Jade Light beam lasting 3 seconds, up to a maximum of 8 beams.
  - Beams cannot target most Bosses, except Acolytes.
  - Each enemy can only have one beam, but one beam can damage multiple enemies if they are close enough.
  - The arsenal only displays the duration rounded to the nearest full second, despite the unrounded number being used for the ability.
- The augment uses the well's stats as it is formed. In other words, the well snapshots Jade's Ability Strength and Ability Duration at the moment it lands on a surface, and those snapshotted values are used for the augment.
- The Jade Light beams initially deal 100 Heat damage with a guaranteed Status Effect, and each subsequent hit will deal double the damage of the previous one. Damage is dealt immediately as the beam spawns, then once every half second plus a 1-frame delay.
  - Damage is affected by Judgment, naturally boosting the initial base damage to 150.
  - Because of the delay, reaching an exact multiple of 16.67% Duration will not yield an additional tick of damage; a minuscule amount of extra Duration is required beyond that. For example, 100% Ability Duration will give a beam duration of 3s, but a tick of damage will not be dealt at the 3 second mark. With 101% Duration however, an additional tick will occur at the 3 second mark, for a total of 7 ticks instead of 6.
- Like the Jade Light Eximus, the beam comes from a destructible orb, though enemies will not deliberately target it. Nullifier bubbles can destroy the orb on contact.
  - Demolisher pulses will not destroy the orb.
  - Unlike the Jade Light Eximus, the orbs from this augment are attached to their target's exact position.
- The beams take on Jade's primary energy color, however, client players will always see the default light green of Jade Light beams (including for Jade herself if she is not host).
Conseils :
- Enemies affected by multiple wells will take damage from each, which increases the amount of times the roll for a beam is performed.
- Due to the exponential growth of the beam's damage, focusing on Ability Duration can lead to higher damage values. Ability Strength shouldn't be completely ignored however, as it is still important for increasing the beam spawn chance.
  - Arcane Concentration increases the well's duration, even if Concentration was not active prior to casting, though the well must be formed before Concentration expires.
Jet Stream:
- Both movement speed and weapon Projectile Speed are affected by Ability Strength.
- Buff to allies is affected by Ability Range.
- Players retain the Jet Stream buff for an additional 3 seconds after leaving Turbulence's range.
- The charged attacks of thrown melee weapons like the Glaive benefit from the Projectile Speed increase.
- The Projectile Speed increase affects the damage falloff distance of weapons that have it, such as shotguns, similarly to Projectile Speed mods.
Kumihimo Loading:
- The number of kills required is affected by Ability Efficiency, reaching a floor of 2 kills per loaded die at maximum Efficiency.
- The mod's benefit caps at 5 dice, matching Koumei's full diceroll and can be attained without much effort.
Larva Burst:
- Explosion triggers upon reactivating Larva while it is active. Reactivation detonates Larva and does not cost energy.
- Upon detonation, Larva explodes in an 8m radius, dealing 600 Toxin damage multiplied by the number of enemies initially caught by Larva.
  - Explosion does not require line of sight and bypasses obstacles in the environment to damage all enemies in range.
  - Explosion has 100% Damage Falloff over its radius.
    - Has virtually no falloff against enemies caught by Larva, due to them being at the center of the explosion.
- Each enemy hit by the explosion will receive 1 Toxin Status Effect multiplied by the number of enemies initially caught by Larva.
  - The damage of each Toxin stack is equal to 50% of the explosion damage received by the enemy, dealt once per second for 6 seconds.
    - Damage falloff will reduce the explosion damage received by far away enemies, and thus the DoT damage from the resulting Toxin procs.
- On detonation, each remaining enemy inside Larva has a 50% chance to generate 1/5th of a Mutation stack. The stack chance is capped at 100% chance per enemy at 200% Ability Strength.
  - Nearby enemies hit by the explosion will not generate additional stacks, only enemies that are within Larva when it is detonated.
  - Captured enemies that are killed before detonation will not generate stacks upon detonation. However, enemies still have a 50% chance to generate 1/5th of a stack if they are killed by any source while captured by Larva (a feature of the un-augmented version of Larva).
- Explosion and Toxin DoT damage are not affected by Mutation stacks.
- Damage and Toxin stack count are calculated based on the number of enemies grabbed during the initial cast, meaning killing enemies caught in Larva will not reduce explosion or Toxin DoT damage.
- Grabbed enemies are briefly launched up in the air on detonation.
Conseils :
- As both the explosion damage and Toxin stack count scale with the number of enemies caught, the total ability damage scales quadratically with the number of enemies.
  - While the ability can quickly dispatch large groups, it may sometimes be preferable to instead use Virulence on the enemies grouped up by Larva, as the ability can generate a significant amount of energy.
- Emerald Archon Shards can be used to increase the Toxin status damage from the explosion.
- Roar will increase the initial explosion damage and then further increase the Toxin status, drastically increasing the overall damage dealt.
- Particularly effective against Narmer due to their weakness to Toxin, as well as the Corpus due to Toxin ignoring shields.
- Ancient Disruptors will reduce the damage dealt, and Toxic Ancients will eliminate toxin damage from nearby Infested.
Lasting Covenant:
- Bonus duration awarded from weak points is affected by Ability Duration.
- The duration of an active critical chance buff cannot exceed three times the buff's base duration.
  - With an Ability Duration of 130%, Covenant would grant 15.6s of critical chance buff initially, and bonus time would cap at 46.8s.
  - Buff duration can be continually replenished up to the cap with additional weak point kills, allowing for unlimited duration as long as the user continues to land weak point kills frequently enough.
Conseils :
- Synergizes well with Harrow's first ability, Condemn, as it puts enemies in a position that allows for easier headshots.
Lingering Transmutation: - The lingering probe will reduce the cooldowns of all other Lavos' abilities every time it deals damage, as opposed to the standard probe which can only reduce cooldowns once per enemy hit.
Loyal Merulina:
- Cannot be equipped alongside Merulina Guardian.
- Yareli still receives the Damage Redirection as if she was still riding Merulina.
  - Merulina's armor no longer affects the redirected damage it takes. This includes armor gained from Azure Archon Shards.
- Yareli will lose her immunity to stagger status effects from enemy targets (such as Knockdown); however she will still be immune from self-inflicted stagger by weapons she uses. It's unclear if this is intentional or not, as riding Merulina normally provides complete status immunity, including knockdown immunity from enemies.
- Loyal Merulina's Sea Snares inherits the duration, range, damage per second, damage increase per second, and damage vulnerability stats of Yareli's own Sea Snares. This is still the case even if Yareli's Sea Snares ability is overridden by another Helminth ability.
  - Sea Snare cooldown is affected by Ability Efficiency, reducing the cooldown to a minimum of 0.5 seconds at 175% efficiency.
    - Ability Snap Shots Ability Efficiency on cast
      - Using Arcane Sculptor activated by Aquablades can provide max 175% efficiency
  - Duration of Sea Snares cast by Merulina are shown on Merulina's ability icon.
  - Unlike Yareli's version of the ability, Loyal Merulina's Sea Snares are cast one at a time rather than in groups of five.
  - Damage vulnerability from the Sea Snares from Loyal Merulina stack with regular Sea Snares from her 1 and is multiplicative like all forms of damage vulnerability.
  - Loyal Merulina's Sea Snares will grant stacks of Arcane Camisado, but does not scale with summon damage bonuses, like from Summoner's Wrath.
Mach Crash:
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
- Vortex duration is not affected by mods.
Magnetized Discharge:
- Press 2 while aiming at a Magnetize bubble to detonate it for no energy cost. Enemies caught in the explosion have a 12.5% / 25% / 37.5% / 50% chance to be disarmed by the blast.
  - Disarm chance is affected by Ability Strength. 100% disarm chance is achievable with at least 200% Ability Strength.
- Both manual detonation and Magnetize bubble duration expiring can trigger the disarm chance.
- Manual detonation will only detonate the targeted Magnetize bubble. If overlapping sections of 2 or more Magnetize bubbles are targeted, the closest bubble will be targeted and explode.
- If you are standing inside a bubble it will still make it explode even if you aim on a target outside the bubble.
- Passive range increase is additive with other Ability Range increases.
Conseils :
- This augment is useful whenever hostile Nullifier Crews are expected to appear, to allow Mag to detonate the bubble early instead of letting it be cancelled out by a Nullifier bubble and waste the accumulated damage.
Mending Splinters:
- Only friendly targets affected by Splinter Storm are eligible for healing.
  - Kavats and Kubrows receive healing if their owner is being healed.
- Additional healing is granted regardless of whether the target is an enemy, an ally, or the user.
- No additional healing is granted for enemies being damaged by Splinter Storm's area of effect damage.
- Healing amount is affected by Ability Strength.
- Works on Defense Objects.
- Rather than health over time, Mending Splinters actually will give a flat 15 chunk of health every second, and each target has a separate timer when it was cast. As such, actual healing rate will be slightly different while still technically giving the player 15 health per target, every second.
Merulina Guardian:
- Heal is affected by Ability Strength.
- Buff duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Reload Speed and Fire Rate bonuses are not affected by mods.
- Buff only triggers if Merulina isn't at full HP.
Conseils :
- You can run out of ammo very quickly with the high fire rate and reload speed buff gained from activating the augment, especially on weapons that consume a lot of ammo/are not so ammo efficient by default, like the Atomos or the Twin Grakatas. To counteract this, it would be best to either slot Pistol Ammo Mutation/Primed Pistol Ammo Mutation in the exilus slot of your weapon, run Pistol Scavenger as your aura mod, or use Arcane Pistoleer if your weapon of choice is compatible.
  - Alternatively, you may consider firing your weapon in short bursts instead, to avoid potential ammo wastage.
  - Weapons with infinite ammo, such as Grimoire and Tenet Plinx, or charges, such as Incarnons, are able to bypass these ammo issues.
- The healing done to Merulina can trigger Archon Intensify.
- Can use the aura mod Combat Discipline to trigger the augment's bonuses consistently and without risk (in case there's no damage to receive from enemies attacking Yareli while riding Merulina), as the 90% damage reduction from Merulina minimizes the mod's health loss to only 1 point per kill.
  - The health damage to Yareli can be completely circumvented by using Combat Discipline at rank 2. While this means it provides 6 less mod capacity compared to a fully ranked counterpart, it prevents accidental deaths in missions where health orbs are scarce, or disabled entirely.
- Since semi-auto weapons have a fire rate cap of 10, any semi-auto with over ~3.33 base fire rate will not be able to use the full fire rate buff.
  - If Reinforced Bond and Amalgam Furax Body Count are installed, semi-auto weapons with a base fire rate above ~2.46 will have a portion of this buff wasted.
- Semi-Pistol Cannonade will prevent the weapon it is equipped on from receiving the 200% fire rate buff, but it will still benefit from the 200% reload speed.
- While the fire rate and reload speed buffs are not affected by mods, investing in Ability Strength is still beneficial. Since the damage vulnerability from Sea Snares scales with strength, investment in this stat will make it easier to kill an enemy caught by the snare and proc this augments buffs.
Mesa's Waltz:
- Mesa's movement speed is equal to her walking speed while Zooming with a weapon, multiplied by the Augment's Movement Speed. In total, she moves at 25% of her normal walking speed with a Rank 3 Mesa's Waltz, unlike what the text of the Mod may suggest.
- The Movement Speed reduction is considered to be a Slow effect. If Mesa gains immunity to Slow, such as by using Poise, her walking speed will increase to her Zooming speed.
- With this mod equipped, the focus ring reticle will grow back gradually when not firing. This both increases the targeting angle and decreases the accumulated damage bonus.
- Mesa's Waltz allows Mesa to suffer a Hard Landing from falling. Mesa cannot start firing the Regulators during the hard landing animation, but it does not prevent Mesa from continuing to shoot if she started shooting in mid-air, as long as the player does not release the input during the animation.
  - Hard landings can still be avoided by rolling.
- Mesa's Waltz also allows Mesa to be Staggered.
Conseils :
- Mesa is still able to roll while Peacemaker is active, which can be further augmented with Amalgam Barrel Diffusion or any buffs to Parkour Velocity.
Mesmer Shield:
- Bonuses are not affected by mods.
- Can stack with Reave to grant allies up to 6 charges at max mod rank.
Mind Freak: - Additive with the 750% initial and conversion damage bonuses from Mind Control.
Molecular Fission:
- At max rank, two charges are restored per kill.
  - Chance for additionally restored charges is not affected by Ability Strength.
  - Kills by Allies or Companions on primed enemies will replenish the null star particle count up to the cap.
- Number of charges is capped at the number you would get from using Null Star, which is affected by Ability Duration.
  - Maximum number of charges that Molecular Fission will restore is based on a snapshot of Ability Duration at the time of casting of Null Star, which includes temporal buffs like Ris Invocation or Arcane Concentration.
- Molecular Fission can produce a constant supply of null star particles over the duration of combat, providing a low effort addition to outgoing ability damage for as long as the player doesn't run out of active particles.
- Neutron Star may be better suited for quickly replacing large numbers of null star particles than Molecular Fission, with the added benefit of spreading large amounts of Heat and Blast.
- Particles will not be spawned unless at least one particle is active, requiring a minimum of one Null Star cast per mission.
- Null Star particles prime enemies with slowed or sped up version of Molecular Prime, depending on which version was used last. By default it has a slow effect.
  - The version will be changed right after casting Molecular Prime and doesn't require recasting.
- Can't be equipped on subsumed Null Star, as other Warframes don't have Molecular Prime ability.
Muzzle Flash:
- Flash radius and duration affected by Ability Range and Ability Duration respectively.
  - Flash originates on the players buffed by Shooting Gallery, so Mesa herself and up to 1 other player.
- Mesa herself counts as an "assisting player" and can trigger the flash solo.
- Flash stacks show as a percentage on the UI buff icon.
- Regardless of how kills were achieved (e.g. shots, procs, or abilities) the flash will only be triggered by an attack.
- Blinded enemies are vulnerable to Finishers.
- Cannot blind enemies with Overguard.
