Negation Armor:
- Cooldown begins when the effect triggers.
- Upon activating, Inaros will heal 90% of his Health and become invulnerable for 3 seconds. Once the invulnerability ends, he receives a Slash proc that deals ~20% of his max health per second.
  - The Slash proc cannot be prevented, by recasting Scarab Shell, using Arcane Deflection, or gaining Overguard.
Conseils :
- Rapid Resilience affects Negation Armor's Slash proc, making it non-lethal if Inaros has at least ~20% of his max Health.
- Arcane Persistence caps the Slash proc damage as expected.
- Sandstorm can be used to make Inaros invulnerable during the Slash proc period, while also allowing him to heal any health lost.
- Rolling Guard, Remedium, and other forms of Status Cleanse can remove the Slash proc.
Neutron Star:
- The mod's description is a bit ambiguous, the 8m refers to the AoE radius when a projectile hits, rather than the range of the targeting.
- Explosion damage is affected by Ability Strength.
- Explosion radius is affected by Ability Range.
- Seek radius after 5 meters and explosion require line of sight.
Conseils :
- The augment deals a separated instance of Heat damage and status from Null Star, highly benefiting from the same modifiers that can affect Null Star, such as Arcane Arachne, Holster Amp, Vigorous Swap, among others.
- The guaranteed proc chance makes the augment useful for short-range crowd control.
- The augment allows the user to refresh the innate damage reduction that each Null Star innately possess.
Noctua Swarm:
- When Noctua's Alternate Fire impacts a wall or floor, an area of effect with an 8 meter radius is created at the point of impact, lasting 15 seconds. Dive-bombing Paragrimms bombard the zone, repeatedly Stunning any enemies within. Enemies take 500 Slash damage once every second with a forced status effect.
  - Only one zone may be active at a time. If the Alternate Fire is used again and creates a new damaging zone, the previous one is removed.
- All enemies in the zone are Silenced, preventing the use of Eximus abilities and other special attacks, and subjected to repeated Stun effects.
  - Silence is effective against many enemies, including (but not limited to):
    - Legacytes, Acolytes (including disabling the Silence field of Violence, Rogue Voidrigs, all Eximus units, both Whispers, and Bosses that use Warframe abilities.
    - The Silence applies even while enemies still have Overguard or are damage-immune.
  - Similar to Banshee's Silence, non-Boss enemies in range are Stunned and perform the Blind animation, but are not open to finishers.
    - The zone created by Noctua Swarm chain-stuns enemies in range repeatedly until the zone expires or is moved.
    - Invulnerable enemies like Vampyric Liminus can also be crowd controlled if they have a valid Blind animation, and count towards enemy count for the regen buff.
- Each living enemy within the zone grants the Noctua Swarm buff, restoring 2 Energy per second to all players within 25 meters.
  - The regen caps out at 20 energy per second with 10 enemies in the zone, although the zone can damage more than 10 enemies at a time.
  - The energy regen buff is only active while enemies are alive in the zone. Reducing the number of living enemies in the zone also reduces the buff's value.
  - The energy regen buff is applied in a radius measured from the center of the zone, rather than centered on Dante, meaning that Dante is not guaranteed to be in range of his own buff.
    - Once the buff is gained, it will remain on the UI even when players are out of range. However, this is a purely visual bug, and no energy regen occurs while out of range.
  - Energy regen from the buff can be received while in Vehicles or in Operator form.
  - Channeling and attacking with Noctua does not interrupt Noctua Swarm's energy regen, but channeling Gloom or other channeled abilities does interrupt it.
  - Energy regen per stack and max stacks are fixed, and are not affected by Ability Strength.
- The number of Paragrimms in the zone scales with the number of enemies.
  - They seem to have a high Threat Level, as enemies target them before Warframes, including enemies who are immune to the stun effects of the Swarm.
  - Will trigger Arcane Camisado and benefit from Summoner's Wrath, implying that the summons attack. However, trying to buff them with AoE buffs like Nourish will not increase damage output.
- Swarm behavior and damage is not affected by Noctua weapon mods.
- Zone hitbox is a sphere with a fixed 8m radius, and is not affected by Ability Range or Fulmination.
  - Zone can proc Arcane Precision.
  - Zone does not require Line of Sight to enemies in order to damage them.
  - The zone does not trigger Invocation or Canticle mod effects.
- Zone is created immediately on contact with a Nullifier bubble or Frozen Eximus snowglobe.
  - However, it is removed if a Nullifier or Demolisher bubble covers the center of the zone.
- Does not trigger the status vulnerability from Pageflight's Paragrimms.
- The mod will not be available in the modding menu if the Noctua skill has been replaced in the Helminth.
Conseils :
- Noctua's Swarm is a rare source of Silence status effect combined with persistent Stun crowd control.
  - This can be particularly useful in Descendia, where the stun can disable enemy escape in Infernum Penances like Sneaky Retreats or Manic Mania, and the silence reduces Roathe to a glorified Vinquibus (Primary) wielder.
- Though Dante already has a great amount of damage output, Noctua Swarm can help him make kills on enemies faster by disabling their defensive and evasive abilities.
  - When a Legacyte is under the Swarm's effects, it is instantly silenced, and casting a zone on top of a hidden Legacyte pulls it out of invisibility.
  - When Scathing Whisper and Mocking Whisper are under the Swarm's effects, they are both silenced and crowd-controlled, preventing them from teleporting away or using invincibility-granting attacks.
Ore Gaze:
- Extra loot chance is affected by Ability Strength; requiring 400% to achieve 100% chance of loot.
- Extra loot chance does not scale past 100%.
- The extra loot chance does not cause enemies to drop additional Rubble.
- Enemies must stay petrified for the chance at extra loot. If the enemy remains alive after the effects of Petrify expire it must be petrified again.
- Enemies that have already been fully scanned into the Codex can not be scanned by Ore Gaze, making it an ineffective way to scan Kavats for their Genetic Codes.
  - The extra loot drop will still occur on enemies that are fully scanned into the Codex.
- The mod also affects enemies petrified by Path of Statues.
- Additional loot retrieval stacks with other loot abilities that loot while alive (Ivara's Prowl), loot on death (Hydroid's Pilfering Swarm, Khora's Pilfering Strangledome, and Wukong's Monkey Luck passive), and loot corpse (Nekros's Desecrate and Chesa Kubrow's Retrieve).
  - Using Desecrate on a petrified corpse will not cause Ore Gaze to drop additional items beyond what Desecrate would have created normally.
Pacifying Bolts:
- Additional bolts are not affected by mods.
- Cannot stun Demolishers.
- Enemies affected by pacifying bolts are not slept, they are aware of their surroundings and will become alerted by nearby Tenno.
- All bolts will inflict 1 Radiation proc per hit, even on enemies with Overguard (unlike Chaos).
  - Recasting Psychic Bolts will not remove Radiation procs.
  - Psychic Bolts can easily max out Nyx's passive using this augment.
- The stun is a looping flailing animation, which makes it hard to headshot affected enemies but opens shielded enemies (e.g. Elite Shield Lancer) for easy kills from the front.
- The stun stops some enemy abilities. For example: Jade Eximus beams will be interrupted and new ones will not activate, meanwhile Ancient pulses and Leech Eximus zones will still activate as normal.
  - The stun cannot be removed by Ancient Healer pulses, but can be removed by Nullifier bubbles.
- Enemies with Overguard will become stunned once it is removed.
Parasitic Vitality:
- Bonus Health scales with Mutations stacks, up to 200x at full mutation for +800% Health, and scales with Ability Strength.
  - This can be further increased by utilizing Abundant Mutation which increases Mutation stacks up to 500. This increases unmodded health by up to +2000%.
  - Bonus is additive to other sources of percentage health increases such as Vigor and Gladiator Resolve.
  - Bonus scales off of base Health, i.e. before any mods or other health bonuses such as Arcane Blessing or Azure Archon Shard's health bonus.
  - The number of Mutation stacks needed to be on par with a maxed Vitality at base Ability Strength is 25 . Increasing Ability Strength will lower this floor .
- Counts as a Vitality mod, thus cannot be used in conjunction with Vitality, Archon Vitality, or Umbral Vitality.
  - The ally linked however, will gain the bonus regardless of their mods.
- Nidus will still gain the bonus health even if linked to an enemy.
- When the link breaks, there is a 5 second countdown before Parasitic Vitality's health bonus disappears until Nidus links with a new target.
- When Nidus gains a mutation stack, his maximum will be updated to reflect the new value and he heals in the process, often enough for a full heal whenever gaining a stack.
  - The healing gained is modified by current health, max health modifiers other than Parasitic Vitality, new stack count, and strength. With a fully ranked augment, gaining a stack heals:
    - Healing received = Current Health × 4% × (1 + Ability Strength) × Mutation Stack Count × (Base Health ÷ Max Health without augment) .
  - This means that modifiers which increase max health, such as Vigor, Arcane Blessing, or Elemental Ward reduce the healing effect (Possible bug).
Conseils :
- While this augment can provide Nidus and his linked ally with plenty of health, potentially up to the quintuple digits with proper modding, keep in mind that his innate health regeneration will not scale to account for the increased health. The easiest way to rectify this is for Nidus to regularly cast Ravenous, but other methods may also be considered:
  - Sources of percentage-based healing, such as Blood Altar, Arcane Grace, Arcane Victory, or Magus Repair.
  - Weapons or abilities with Life Steal, such as Gloom, Hirudo, or Winds of Purity.
    - Sancti Magistar can uniquely heal All allies within 15 meters making it a weapon of choice to sustain allies or companion affected by Parasitic Vitality all while healing Nidus and granting him 20% chance to resist Status Effect
  - The Companion mods Hunter Recovery and/or Synth Deconstruct, particularly on Companions that can damage whole groups of enemies at once such as Panzer Vulpaphyla with Viral Quills, or Hounds with Synergized Prospectus.
    - Hounds could also heal nearby players by copying Eximus powers via Null Audit. Potentially healing other player affected by Parasitic Vitality .
- Using Link Vitality will let Parasitic Vitality affect Nidus companion's Health even when he is linked to another ally or enemy.
  - Link Vitality seems to prevent the healing aspect of Parasitic Vitality, thus causing your companion's max health to be doubled from having both, but no healing to occur, leaving current health at a fraction of a percent of the new max health.
Parry:
- Parry will actually inflict Stun, not Parried.
Conseils :
- Without this mod, blocking a melee attack has an approximately 50% chance to trigger a Parry, which opens the enemy up to a Finisher attack. With this mod equipped, nearly every block will be a parry.
- When you get close to a ranged enemy, they will most likely switch to melee attacks to defend themselves. Block this attack to enable a counter-attack finisher.
- Finisher attacks triggered by Parry are affected by bonuses to True damage.
- Disarming enemies' ranged weapons (with effects like Loki's Radial Disarm) will force foes to switch to melee attacks, which can be parried.
- Certain special attacks cannot be parried, nor trigger a counterattack finisher, though they will be blocked.
  - Grappling hook attacks (such as from the Grineer Scorpion or Infested Ancient Disruptor) will be blocked but not parried.
  - Normal knockback and knockdown rules for blocking still apply. Heavy enemy attacks like Seismic Shockwave or the Shield Lancer's charge will still trigger knockback but will not knock down a blocking player.
Partitioned Mallet:
- Two Mallets cannot be placed within each other's radii.
  - It is, however, possible for a Resonator carrying a Mallet to enter the radius of another Mallet, or for 2 Mallets' radii to overlap if both are under the effects of Amp.
- The damage ticks from both Mallets can affect the same enemies, provided they are within the radius of both.
- Resonator can only carry 1 Mallet. If Resonator is summoned while both Mallets are present, it will go for the closest one.
- Amp only affects the last Mallet summoned, unless the radii of both Mallets are in Octavia's sight.
  - If Mallet is recast while Amp is active, Amp must be recast for that Mallet to benefit from it.
Peaceful Provocation:
- Pacify's maximum slow and Provoke's maximum bonus Ability Strength percentages are affected by Ability Strength.
  - Maximum extra Ability Strength bonus is capped at 30%.
  - Maximum enemy slow is capped at 80%.
- Pacify's damage taken to Slow Aura conversion is as follows: Every 1% of Maximum Health + Shields lost by Equinox and allies within Pacify's range increases the slow aura by +0.25%.
  - Conversion is not affected by Ability Strength.
  - Damage to Overguard is not converted.
- Provoke's damage dealt to Ability Strength conversion is as follows: Every 1% of maximum enemy Health + Shields dealt increases the bonus ability strength by +0.02%.
  - Conversion is not affected by Ability Strength.
  - Damage to Overguard is not converted.
  - Ability strength bonus is rounded to the nearest 1%.
- Equinox retains Peaceful Provocation's effects as long as Pacify or Provoke remains active. Switching between forms will reset the bonus.
- Peaceful Provocation's current percentages are displayed beside Equinox's shield and health indicators.
Phoenix Renewal:
- Prevents the down from occurring at all, so any abilities or effects relating to taking fatal damage will not trigger. Does not synergize with Quick Thinking or Gladiator Finesse, as it activates before they deplete energy.
- Will affect Companions.
  - Companions use a separate cooldown.
- Both the Warframes and Operators can be saved, but the cooldown is tied to the Tenno.
- Does not work on allied NPCs.
- Works in Arbitrations.
- Upon triggering, a message is displayed on the screen of the player that was saved. They are then given a red Renewal icon as a debuff to indicate the cooldown.
  - Even though multiple Renewals stack together, the augment's cooldown is universal - multiple Oberons equipped with the augment will not provide multiple separate Phoenix Renewal triggers.
Piercing Navigator:
- The Critical Chance bonus is flat, applying after mods.
  - For example, a Boltor with Point Strike equipped and after 5 hits controlled by Navigator will have a total of 10% × (1 + 150%) + 250% =275% critical chance.
- Critical Chance bonus is not affected by Ability Strength.
- Punch Through bonus is affected by Ability Range.
- In the case of Zenistar, Grimoire, and similar attack-generating projectiles - the central "source" projectile itself must touch enemies in order to gain the bonus.
- The UI buff icon will display your current final crit chance after all calculations, instead of showing the Navigator's crit bonus.
Piercing Roar:
- Applies 5 Puncture stacks to all enemies in range, reducing their damage by 80% and increasing the critical chance of incoming weapon attacks by a flat +25%.
  - Does not require line of sight to hit enemies.
- Deals 100 Puncture damage to all affected enemies. Damage does not scale with Ability Strength, but the Roar buff is applied before the damage is dealt, increasing the Puncture damage on every cast by 50% (or 30% for the subsumed version).
- Knockdown and Puncture proc range is affected by Ability Range, but not by the 40% range buff from the augment itself, which applies only to the range of the Roar buff.
- The duration of the Puncture status applied by this augment is affected by Ability Duration.
- Any existing buff by Roar gets cancelled when recasting Roar.
Conseils :
- This mod applies two different status effects (Knockdown and Puncture) to nearby enemies, making it effective as a primer for Condition Overload.
Pilfering Strangledome:
- Drop chance is not affected by mods.
- Additional loot retrieval stacks with other loot abilities that loot while alive (Ivara's Prowl), loot while petrified (Atlas's Ore Gaze), and loot corpse (Nekros's Desecrate and Chesa Kubrow's Retrieve). However, it does not stack with other loot on death abilities (Hydroid's Pilfering Swarm, Khora's Pilfering Strangledome, and Wukong's Monkey Luck passive).
Conseils :
- This mod synergizes very well with anything that can help pull enemies into a cluster within the chains and thus generate a higher chance at yielding loot, such as Proboscis Cernos, Nidus's Larva, Vauban's Bastille in Vortex mode and Minelayer in Tether Coil mode, Khora's Ensnare, Mag's short-tap Magnetize, Yareli's Riptide, Gyre's detonated Coil Horizon, the Vazarin school's Void Snare, or Nautilus's Cordon precept.
- While Hydroid's Pilfering Swarm can benefit with Overextended, the same mod may have a counterproductive effect on Khora's version, as having a very large Strangledome makes enemies hang too far from each other and thus can be harder to take out en masse.
- While in an Excavation mission, Power Carrier enemies have a chance to drop additional Power Cells when caught by Pilfering Strangledome.
Pilfering Swarm:
- Enemies held by Pilfering Swarm tentacles and killed by any sources have a chance to drop additional loot.
  - If there are enemies that can’t be picked up by the tentacles (e.g. enemies affected by Petrify or immune to crowd control), they need to be killed by the tentacles to drop additional loot.
- Works against Ospreys and other flying enemies.
- Additional loot retrieval stacks with other loot abilities that loot while alive (Ivara's Prowl), loot while petrified (Atlas's Ore Gaze), and loot corpse (Nekros's Desecrate and Chesa Kubrow's Retrieve). However, it does not stack with other loot on death abilities (Hydroid's Pilfering Swarm, Khora's Pilfering Strangledome, and Wukong's Monkey Luck passive).
Conseils :
- This mod synergizes very well with anything that can help pull enemies into a cluster within the tentacles and thus generate a higher chance at yielding loot, such as Proboscis Cernos, Nidus's Larva, Vauban's Bastille in Vortex mode, Khora's Ensnare, Mag's short-tap Magnetize, Yareli's Riptide, Gyre's detonated Coil Horizon, the Vazarin school's Void Snare, or Nautilus's Cordon precept.
- As drop chance is unaffected by Ability Strength, players can focus on maximizing Pilfering Swarm's coverage via Overextended.
Pool Of Life:
- Health Orb drops are not affected by mods.
- Energy Orb drop chance is affected by Ability Strength, potentially increasing the number of dropped Energy Orbs.
Primal Rage:
- Primal Rage has a bonus cap of +150% critical chance. At full stacks Iron Staff's critical chance will be 62.5%.
  - This Augment only provides bonus critical chance to Iron Staff.
  - The critical chance bonus is additive with critical chance mods.
    - For example, with a max-ranked True Steel and Primal Rage's bonus at 150%, Iron Staff will have: Base Critical Chance × (1 + Critical Chance Mods + Primal Fury) = 25% × (1 + 1.2 + 1.5) = 92.5% critical chance
- Critical chance per kill is affected by Ability Strength while the decay rate is affected by Ability Duration.
  - The maximum bonus critical chance cap of 150% is not affected by mods.
  - For example, with a max-ranked Intensify and Primal Rage, Iron Staff will gain: Base Critical Chance per Kill × (1 + Strength Mods) = 15% × (1 + 0.3) = 19.5% critical chance per kill
  - With a max-ranked Continuity, the critical chance decay rate becomes: Base Decay Rate ÷ (1 + Duration Mods) = 1% ÷ (1 + 0.3) = 0.7692%/sec
- Wukong retains Primal Rage's effects as long as Primal Fury remains active, and the bonus will reset if Primal Fury is deactivated by any means.
- Primal Rage's current percentages are displayed beside Wukong's shield and health indicators.
Prism Guard:
- Prism still retains its energy drain over the duration.
Conseils :
- Using a bright energy color can impair visibility, so switching Mirage's energy color to something darker is recommended.
Prismatic Companion:
- This mod's duration bonus is multiplicative with typical ability duration increases. Functionally, it increases the default duration to 45 seconds.
- "Free-moving" refers to Kubrows, Kavats, MOAs, Predasites, Vulpaphyla, and Hounds. The gem will not attach to Sentinels or Vulpaphylas in their larval state (Sly Devolution, Crescent Devolution, or Panzer Devolution), and will instead cast normally.
- Diversified Denial will interfere with the augment, negating the activation.
Prolonged Paralysis:
- Duration increase is affected by Ability Strength.
- The pull strength is affected by Ability Strength.
- The base pull range of 10 meters is affected by Ability Range.
- The enemy pull effect is gradual and not instantaneous.
- Enemies pulled in are vulnerable to grounded melee Finishers.
Purging Slash:
- Allies do not include the player that casted the ability, their companions, or defense objects.
- Amount of debuffs removed is affected by Ability Strength.
- Shield restoration amount is not affected by mods.
- Can grant Overshields.
Purifying Flames:
- Status immunity duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- The Status Immunity works on the caster of Fire Blast, even if they are not Ember.
Pyroclastic Flow:
- Nezha kicks a trail 20 meters in the direction he is aiming. Unlike Fire Walker's basic casting animation, Pyroclastic Flow will not interrupt charging.
- Only the ability damage itself from Fire Walker accumulates damage, thereforeHeat status damage does not contribute.
- Damage accumulation multiplier and trail range are not affected by mods.
- Trail duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Pyroclastic Flow inflicts a guaranteed Heat proc.
- The damage is stored before armor and resistances are taken into account.
- Damage stored is shown in the HUD below the respective ability icon and applies once every 0.5 seconds effectively doubling the damage per second from the ability one might expect.
- Accumulated damage will stay stored even after Fire Walker's duration expires and will not be removed by being dispelled by Nullifier Crewmen or falling out of bounds. Casting Fire Walker after it has expired will activate Pyroclastic Flow in addition to reactivating Fire Walker.
- Flames that linger beyond Fire Walker timing out or being dispelled will not accumulate damage.
Radiant Finish:
- Damage vulnerability is affected by Ability Strength.
- Final multiplier is calculated as (1+Finisher Damage Vulnerability). For example at 100% strength this gives 4x finisher damage. At 200% Strength this grants 7x finisher damage.
- Multiplicative to Finishing Touch.
- Multiplicative with Savage Silence Augment to Silence.
Conseils :
- Synergizes very well with Ash's Blade Storm, as it deal pure Finisher damage.
Razor Mortar:
- In addition to grouping enemies hit by the ability, all Ortholysts will teleport close to the enemies that were grouped by Razor Gyre.
- The teleportation effect and buffs will only activate if Razor Gyre successfully hits 1 or more enemies who are susceptible to crowd control effects.
  - Only hitting enemies immune to crowd control effects such as those with Overguard will result in the augment not taking effect.
- Duration of the buffs are affected by Ability Duration.
- Fire Rate andElectricity damage buffs are affected by Ability Strength.
- The pull has an unlisted base range of 5 meters, affected by Ability Range.
- The Electricity damage dealt by Ortholysts proc Archon Stretch, per Update 39.1.
Razorwing Blitz:
- While in Razorwing, casting any Warframe ability (including those infused via Helminth) will grant 25% Flight Speed and 25% Fire Rate, lasting for 8s. These effects stack with each cast, up to a max of 100% Flight Speed and 100% Fire Rate, lasting for 32s.
  - Further casts after the 4th will only increase the remaining buff duration, not increase the buff value.
  - The buff does not lose "stacks" over time; in other words, the buff remains at the maximum value that has been reached until the buff ends.
  - When the bonuses are active, an icon showing the percentage of the buff and its remaining duration is visible in the buff HUD, next to the player's Health and Shields bars.
  - The buffs will be removed early if Razorwing is deactivated.
- Flight Speed buff increases both Movement Speed and Sprint Speed.
  - Movement Speed bonus stacks additively with similar buffs, such as Molt.
  - Sprint Speed bonus stacks additively with similar buffs, such as Rush.
  - Movement speed and sprint speed bonuses are multiplicative to each other, quadratically increasing Titania's sprinting flight speed as her ability strength increases.
- { Flight Speed =10×(1+Razorwing Blitz Bonus+Other Movement Speed Bonuses) ; Sprinting Flight Speed =20×(1+Razorwing Blitz Bonus+Other Movement Speed Bonuses)×(1+Razorwing Blitz Bonus+Other Sprint Speed Bonuses) }
- Fire Rate buff increases both Dex Pixia's Fire Rate and Diwata's Attack Speed.
  - Bonus stacks additively with similar buffs, such as Gunslinger and (Primed) Fury, respectively.
- Visually, the Flight Speed buff is limited to 1200% on the in game HUD.
- Buff values are affected by Precision Intensify.
- Buff values are determined by Titania's current Ability Strength value when Razorwing is cast, not when the buff itself is triggered by casting an ability.
  - This means that conditional increases like Growing Power and Empower should be activated before using Razorwing. More time-consuming or unpredictable sources (like Molt Augmented or a Void Fissure's corruption) will require recasting of Razorwing if the ability was already in use before obtaining the buff.
- The buff does not affect the flight speed or attack speed of Razorflies.
Conseils :
- Building for Ability Strength increases both Dex Pixia's base damage and fire rate, scaling up its DPS very rapidly.
  - High fire rate can lead to ammo issues, which can be mitigated by tap-shooting in short bursts or by using Arcane Pistoleer to gain infinite ammo on weak point kills.
- Due to Razorwing Blitz increasing both movement speed and sprint speed, Razorwing's sprinting speed can quickly become unmanageable at higher Ability Strength values.
  - Refraining from sprinting and instead using Razorwing's normal flight mode is much more controllable, and still quite fast even with just a moderate amount of Ability Strength.
Reactive Storm:
- The status chance increase granted by this augment is affected by Ability Strength and additive with any other status chance mods.
  - For example, using a maxed Intensify, Drifting Contact, and Reactive Storm results in: Base status chance × [1 + (Reactive Storm Bonus × (1 + Strength Mods)) + Status Mods] = 0.15 × [1 + (2.5 × 1.3) + 0.4] = 69.7% status chance
  - To achieve 100% status chance without any status chance mods, Ability Strength must be at least 227%.
- Only Desert Wind's Impact damage is altered to match as enemies weakest damage type.
  - Melee Impact mods such as Primed Heavy Trauma, increase the amount of altered elemental damage, but do not retain an Impact damage type after alteration.
  - If damage becomes a primary element, it will not combine with other modded primary elements.
- To adapt damage types, Baruuk can strike with both his fists/feet at close range or Desert Wind's long-range waves.
  - Once set (by the last enemy struck by fists), the new damage type will affect the waves.
  - Damage type will reset to Impact when Serene Storm deactivates.
- Damage type will prioritize combined and non-physical elements and the first element a given faction is vulnerable to based on the in-game UI, limiting its potential damage conversions to the following:
  - Heat (Infested)
  - Electricity (Anarchs)
  - Toxin (Narmer)
  - Corrosive (Grineer, Kuva Grineer, Zariman, and Scaldra)
  - Magnetic (Corpus, Corpus Amalgam, and Techrot)
  - Viral (Orokin)
  - Radiation (Sentient and The Murmur)
  - Gas (Infested Deimos)
- Damage Resistance reduction by Magus Accelerant, Magus Destruct or Petrify will influence the new damage type.
- Damage type does not change in response to Sentient damage adaptation. It will adapt as normal to a Sentient's weaknesses, but will not change if the Sentient adapts.
- Damage remains Impact as when adapting to an enemy without any health type, or while Overguard is present.
Conseils :
- Due to the large status chance boost this augment gives, it pairs well with Condition Overload. Furthermore, players can forgo dual status-elemental mods, such as Volcanic Edge, and use mods that only increase Elemental Damage, like Molten Impact, to further increase Desert Wind's total damage.
- The status chance boost also simplifies creating a Crit-Status hybrid build as status chance mods are no longer necessary.
Reaping Chakram:
- As the augment increases the chance for health orbs above 100%, it can cause enemies to drop multiple health orbs.
- Passing through the same enemy multiple times will still count towards the multiplier.
- The multiplier affects the damage after Ability Strength is taken into account.
  - Multiplier itself is not affected by Ability Strength.
  - Multiplier affects total damage, making the scaling (1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 )n, where n is the number of times Blazing Chakram passes through an enemy.
  - Multiplier is also applied to the Heat proc done by the chakram.
  - There is no cap to the possible damage boost.
Recharge Barrier:
- Only activates once per shield placed.
- Is affected by Power Strength.
Recrystalize:
- Enemies killed while affected by a Crystal Growth will instantly spread Crystals to all unaffected enemies within 16 meters.
  - The killing blow does not have to be landed on an enemy's Crystal in order to trigger the effect.
  - The spread range does not require Line of Sight.
  - Enemies affected by Recrystallize will trigger the effect on their death as well, allowing the effect to trigger multiple times from a single ability cast.
- Enemies affected by Recrystallize will NOT be frozen in place, but instead dealt 500 Impact damage with a forced proc and stagger.
- Each newly crystallized enemy will have the full 8 second duration of Crystalize, regardless of the remaining duration on the killed enemy that spread the effect.
  - This can enable the effect to last indefinitely, so long as there are enough new enemies to spread Crystals to.
  - Crystallized enemies will not have their Crystallize duration reset if Recrystallize is triggered again nearby.
Regenerative Molt:
- Saryn heals an amount of health per tick for 10 ticks over 10 seconds.
- Amount healed per tick is affected by Ability Strength.
- Is not affected by Ability Duration.
- The regeneration effect does not end early if Molt's decoy is destroyed by damage. However, it doesend when Molt expires naturally if the decoy duration drops below 9 seconds.
  - Regenerative Molt restores at a rate of one tick per second. The total number of healing ticks is equal to healing duration in seconds, rounded up to a maximum of 10.
  - Examples:
    - If Molt's duration is 20 seconds long, Regenerative Molt will heal for 10 ticks.
    - If Molt's duration is 9.1 seconds long, Regenerative Molt will still heal for 10 ticks.
    - If Molt's duration is 5.6 seconds long, Regenerative Molt will heal for only 6 ticks.
  - The minimum threshold to recieve all 10 ticks is 23% Ability Duration.
- Regenerative Molt Ability Strength scaling is 0.5 hp per tick for every additional 1% ability strength. (rounded down)
  - A maxed Intensify giving 30% extra Ability Strength will give the base 50+15 hp per tick.
  - A rank 8 Transient Fortitude with 45% Ability Strength will grant the base 50+22.5 hp per tick – In-game it seems to be rounded down because you will get 22 instead of 23 extra hp per tick.
  - Although Molt's base decoy health should reflect the health restored by 10 ticks at max rank, the actual value may be lower due to rounding.
Reinforcing Stomp:
- The amount of Iron Skin health restored is not affected by mods.
- This augment only replenishes Iron Skin's lost health. It cannot grant more than Iron Skin's maximum amount of health.
Repair Dispensary:
- The Repair Dispensary, after creating Energy Orbs, will generate special pickups resembling Health Orbs that apply their benefits only to Companions.
  - Despite their appearance, they do not function as a traditional Health Orb and provide no healing for Warframes.
- Repair Dispensary projects a holographic Dethcube above itself.
- Since Repair Dispensary adds a new pickup to the Dispensary rotation, it will also delays the spawning of all other pickups by 2 seconds. For instance, instead of Energy Orbs spawning at 6, 12, 18... seconds, they will spawn at 6, 14, 22... seconds.
Reroot Rampage:
- Picking up Fungal Spores during Reroot will spawn a Sprodling, up to a maximum of 10 Sprodlings. Sprodlings follow Nokko, even after Reroot ends.
  - Unlatched Sprodlings following Nokko have infinite duration.
- Sprodling will latch onto an enemy and bounce on them, Stunning them and dealing 250 Toxin Damage in an 8 meter radius per bounce.
  - Each bounce has its damage multiplied by (Bounce Number)1.2.
  - Each bounce increases the Critical Chance of the next bounce by a flat 20%. Sprodlings have an innate 2x Critical Damage multiplier.
  - AoE has damage falloff.
  - Sprodling can bounce a maximum of 20 times (~15 seconds) before despawning. The Sprodling will also despawn if their target dies.
- Sprodlings can activate Arcane Camisado and Archon Continuity.
  - Arcane Camisado will only gain stacks while in Reroot
- Sprodings do not benefit from Summoner's Wrath, Tenacious Bond, Nourish, Emerald Archon Shard Toxin Damage, or Arcane Crepuscular.
Resonance:
- The duration of additional triggers is only affected by the remaining duration of the original sonar, so once the original's duration expires all consecutively created weak spots will expire as well.
- The effects of multiple pulses will stack, rather than overriding each other. Multiple pulses highlighting a single target can cover multiple body parts simultaneously, or sometimes cover the same body part multiple times. See Sonar for detailed highlight mechanics.
  - Resonance can generate spots over the Sonar's visual limit, it may have no limit of its own.
- Pulse range is the same as the base ability (35m) and is affected by Ability Range.
  - Each resonance pulse originates from the location of the target killed, effectively increasing the normal range of the ability if enemies are killed beyond the original casting point.
- Resonance can be triggered by Gas, Electricity, and Blast kills.
- Resonance can be triggered by Ability kills if the enemy torso was highlighted, as most abilities target the torso.
Revealing Spores:
- Radius is affected by Ability Range.
  - Infected enemies inside Revealing Spores's radius are marked with green arrows on the mini map instead of red arrows.
  - Infected enemies outside Revealing Spores's radius but within Saryn's total Enemy Radar are marked with the mini map's usual red arrows.
  - Saryn receives Enemy Radar equal to Revealing Spores's radius. This stacks additively with other sources of Enemy Radar such as Enemy Radar and Animal Instinct.
- Cannot be equipped at the same time as Venom Dose.
- Radar is personal, not shared with teammates.
- The Operator will see infected enemies marked with green arrows on the mini map inside Revealing Spores's radius. They don't get increased Enemy Radar.
- Enemies afflicted with spores stay visible on the map, when the map is jammed with "Signal Disruption" from Regulators and similar effects, even though the normal enemy radar does not function under these conditions.
Conseils :
- With Revealing Spores in combination with Enemy Radar, the player can keep track of infected and uninfected enemies in the mini map, and spread spores accordingly for optimal area coverage.
- When number of infected enemies is too low, Revealing Spores could help in pinpointing them, so the player can attack/kill them to spread more spores, thus make it easier to maintain accumulated damage meter.
Reverse Rotorswell:
- Despite claiming in its description that this mod offers Damage Redirection, the mod actually offers Damage Reduction, which does not affect Overguard, nor provides Status Effect immunity, alongside the damaging effect.
- Damage Reduction caps at 75%, achieved with 215% Ability Strength.
Rhythm Guard:
- Adds an additional UI element under the normal metronome UI, visualising consecutive casts as 4 filling dots.
- Missing a beat only refers to casting out of sync with the backbeat; skipping a beat by not casting does not reset stacks.
  - Does not reset on hitting reset zones (e.g. falling out of map borders).
- Respects timed casts of subsumed abilities.
- Does not activate nor resets from Lizzie alt fire.
- Overguard granted grows exponentially on each cast. At max rank of mod, it gives 100, 200, 400, 800 and 1600 Overguard based on amount of timed casts. Maximal amount of Overguard granted by mod equals 8 casts at max stacks.
  - Amount of Overguard does not scale with Ability Strength, or any other stat besides the rank of the mod.
Conseils :
- Toggling Lizzie on and off can be used to quickly build Beat stacks. Additionally, due to Lizzie removing the Energy cost on Backbeat, this allows Temple to repeatedly activate Rhythm Guard and build Overguard at no Energy cost.
Rift Haven:
- This augment allows Banish to restore health on all banished Warframes, summoned allied units such as Specters, allied Invasion units, Hostages, Kavor Defectors, and Sortie/Arbitration Defense Operatives.
  - This cannot be used to heal Companions or Defense Objects, due to Banish being unable to target them.
  - This cannot heal Eidolon Lures.
- Healing percentage is affected by Ability Strength.
- Healing applies only when ally target is banished to the Rift Plane.
Rift Torrent:
- Damage bonus is affected by Ability Strength.
- Limbo will lose the buff when exiting but will instantly regain it upon entering the Rift Plane.
- Each enemy affected by Rift Surge will increase Limbo's damage by 30% at max Rank. The damage is displayed as a buff with the current percentage.
  - If an enemy affected by Rift Surge dies, the bonus will be updated to the current amount of enemies affected.
  - Enemy does not need to be in the rift for the buff to apply.
  - If more than one Limbo with Rift Torrent is in a squad all players will share and stack each other's bonus'. For example: 1 Player with 20 Surged enemies gives 2,000% damage, an allied limbo will receive it upon entering the Rift. However if that allied Limbo Surges an enemy, and is given 50% damage. The bonus' will stack with each other for 2,050%.
- The damage buff is additive to mods like Serration and Hornet Strike.
  - The modified damage can be calculated using the following formula: Modified Damage = Base Damage × (1 + Rift Torrent Bonus × (1 + Ability Strength) × Number of Affected Enemies + Damage Mods)
  - For example, with a max rank Serration and Intensify, 5 enemies, and a weapon that deals 100 damage, the total modified damage will be:
    - 100 × (1 + 0.3 × (1 + 0.3) × 5 + 1.65) = 460
  - With Exodia Contagion and Glaive explosions Rift Torrent is applied twice. It is additive to mods like Power Throw or Vigorous Swap and it is additive to base damage mods like Serration. The Glaive explosion damage can be calculated using the following formula:
    - Glaive Explosion = Base Damage × (1 + Base Damage Modifiers + Rift Torrent Bonus) × (1 + Rift Torrent Bonus + Vigorous Swap + Power Throw)
- The buff from Rift torrent is same type of damage buff as Vex Armor and Amp. However unlike those abilities Rift Torrent can be combined with Eclipse, Roar or Xata's Whisper
- Applies to the following abilities:
  - Shuriken
  - Null Star
  - Pyrotechnics
  - Airburst Direct hit
  - Breach Surge sparks
    - Rift torrent effectively applies twice to the Breach surge sparks; Once on the initial hit and again on the sparks themselves.
Rising Storm:
- Bonus hits are affected by both Ability Strength and melee combo count chance.
- The augment confers the extra ten second Melee Combo Counter duration regardless of its rank. This bonus duration is not affected by Ability Duration mods.
- Synergizes well with Drifting Contact, Body Count, and Gladiator Rush for a total combo counter duration of 41 seconds at max rank.
Rousing Plunder:
- Heals Hydroid and allies in affinity range by 50 health per enemy in line of sight within 25 meters, plus an additional 50 health for each Corrosive proc removed by Plunder.
  - Heal is affected by Ability Strength.
- Increases max Corrosive damage buff by a flat 100%, applied after Ability Strength modifiers.
  - Corrosive damage buff increase is not affected by Ability Strength
- Increases max Armor buff by 375, applied after Ability Strength modifiers.
  - Armor buff increase is not affected by Ability Strength
Rubble Heap:
- Damage bonus is additive to the one provided by Ability Strength (equivalent to +100% Ability Strength).
  - This diminishes the effectiveness of modding for Ability Strength alongside the Augment.
- Landslide dash range is extended 2x further, targeting enemies up to 24m away.
  - Speed is doubled, so travel time is the same.
- Rubble requirement, damage bonus and dash range are not affected by mods.
- Landslide attack speed and cast time is unchanged.
- Energy cost becomes zero, and no energy is needed to cast landslide.
- Synergizes well with Path of Statues, which eliminates the need to recast Petrify in target-rich environments. This can be used to remove any reliance on your energy pool.
Rumbled:
- Atlas will be encased in stone armor and unequips all weapons. The player's primary fire button will throw boulders, while melee attacking performs a ground slam.
- Health multiplier of the Overguard is affected by Ability Strength.
- Atlas's movement is limited to walking, sprinting and rolling. He cannot jump, crouch, or slide.
  - He can, however, aim glide if he was placed in a high position or in midair.
- The ability lasts for 45 seconds or until the Overguard has been destroyed.
  - Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
  - The visual stone armor will chip off as the Overguard depletes.
  - Atlas can cancel the ability by casting it again.
- Atlas is immune to Status Effects while protected by Rumbled's Overguard.
- Thrown boulders deal 100 Impact damage, with a fixed blast radius of 3 meters. Radial damage deals 75 Impact damage with no damage falloff.
  - Both attacks have 35% Critical Chance, 1.0x Critical Multiplier and 15% Status Chance.
  - Direct hits will ragdoll enemies, while the radial blast will stagger.
- Throw damage scales with Ability Strength and mods equipped on Landslide Fists
  - "Fire rate" scales with Casting Speed.
  - Can trigger and benefit from Melee Arcanes such as Melee Influence, but throws do not stack Melee Exposure.
  - Condition Overload is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits.
  - Unaffected by Attack Speed and Range mods as well as Precision Intensify.
- Melee attacks Slam, dealing 50 Impact damage in a 9 meter radius and ragdolls all targets.
  - Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 0% from 0m to 9m target distance.
  - Damage and range is unaffected by all mods.
  - Cannot proc status effects.
- Atlas can still perform front and back Finisher attacks, though this will use the equipped melee weapon.
- Unaffected by Rubble Heap.
- Throw attacks do not disrupt invisibility from Stalk or Ghost.
- Atlas will be encased in stone armor and unequips all weapons. The player's primary fire button will throw boulders, while melee attacking performs a ground slam.
  - Boulder hits will Knockdown opponents while ground slams will Impair them.
- Atlas cannot jump, crouch, slide or perform any other Maneuvers that require these actions.
  - He can, however, aim glide if he was placed in a high position or in midair.
- The ability lasts for 20 seconds or until the stone armor has been removed.
  - The armor does not deplete over time.
  - The visual rock armor will chip off as its health depletes
  - Atlas can cancel the ability by casting it again.
- Atlas can regenerate shields while in stone armor.
Safeguard Switch:
- Invulnerability period is affected by Ability Duration mods. Duration can be refreshed while active. Can affect multiple allies simultaneously. There is no cooldown to re-cast the ability.
- Loki is only granted the invincibility if he swaps position with an enemy; swapping positions with an ally only clears status effects while giving the ally increased invincibility.
- Casting range is affected by Range mods.
- Casting time is affected by Casting Speed mods.
- Works on other players, companions, allied NPCs, and Loki's own Decoy.
- Loki must cast the ability either on an enemy, an enemy corpse, or even an enemy as it's in its death animation in order to receive the invulnerability.
  - Can be cast on some bosses like The Jackal but not on Archons. Can also be cast on Demolysts/Demolishers, Acolytes, Liches, etc including on Eximus units with their Overguard up.
  - The invulnerability period is only granted to Loki upon completion of the teleport. So then if Loki receives fatal damage before the animation is complete, Loki will still teleport with the target but then will immediately be downed/killed. This can happen either through receiving fatal damage directly during the first portion of the animation (as Loki begins to teleport) or via a status proc where the tick delivers fatal damage during the teleport animation. Therefore increasing Loki's casting speed will reduce this window of opportunity for him to receive fatal damage if his shields are down.
- Cleanses status effects and provides immunity to newly acquired status procs as they tick whilst the invulnerability period is active.
  - If the invulnerability duration expires while there's still status procs active, then those procs will do damage on the remaining ticks.
- Provides immunity to stagger and knockdown.
- Provides immunity to Acolyte, Lich & Eximus abilities including energy drain clouds.
  - The visual FX of energy drain clouds will still play on the screen, however Loki's energy pool will remain unaffected.
- The invulnerability period will not be nullified by Demolyst/Demolisher pulses, nor from walking inside of Nullifier bubbles.
  - This is because the ability grants Loki invulnerability similar to Rolling Guard or mission spawn invulnerability, instead of the ability remaining 'in effect' or 'active' where it is susceptible to being nullified.
  - Loki still cannot cast abilities during the range of an active pulse or from inside of Nullifier bubbles however.
- Will proc Arcane Avenger as Loki is still being 'hit' but takes no damage.
- Allows Loki an easy way to maintain overshields which is useful for activating Cascadia Overcharge.
Safeguard:
- This augment allows Warding Halo to be cast on allied Warframes, Companions, Eidolon Lures, summoned allied units such as Specters, allied Invasion units, Hostages, Kavor Defectors, Sortie and Arbitrations Defense Operatives.
  - The modified Warding Halo only takes into account Nezha's Armor value and Ability Strength at the time of casting, which in turn can be affected by Arcane Enhancements, abilities like Metronome and Power of The Seven, and mods such as Health Conversion or Growing Power.
  - Multiple instances can be active simultaneously.
  - Remaining durability on players can be seen next to the squad UI, however there is no way of knowing the health of rings cast on other units.
  - Just like Safeguard's health, the absorbed damage that can be stacked up in the first 3 seconds is halved, either directly from enemies or environmental hazards
- The "effectiveness" in the augment's description refers only to the Warding Halo's health. Allies still receive the full 90% Damage Reduction while Warding Halo is active on them.
- Casting Warding Halo on friendly units has no range limit but requires line of sight.
- Players under the effects of Safeguard will use the visual effects associated with Warding Halo, using the energy color of the Nezha who cast it.
- Warding Halo does not get removed from allies when the Nezha who cast it goes inside a Nullifier field.
- Going out of bounds and resetting will remove Warding Halo from players but will not remove it from Companions.
Conseils :
- The player who casts Safeguard on allies will be able to see the damage the ring deals when enemies get within range of players. This can be useful in locating enemies far away or locating players that are above or below your level (as the map will place ally icons in one spot until they get on your level again).
- If you have a Chroma in your team, wait until his Vex Armor is charged at maximum capacity before casting your Warding Halo on him, as it will greatly reduce damage received and slow down the rate of Scorn and Fury gain. Once stacked, and if you are inside his aura, this will double or even triple the amount of health of your Warding Halo, even more so with a Cold Elemental Ward.
Savage Silence:
- Damage vulnerability is affected by Ability Strength.
- Damage vulnerability is multiplicative to Finishing Touch.
- Causes Silence's stagger to open enemies to standing finisher attacks. Silence without the Augment will not set up (alerted) enemies for finisher attacks.
  - Staggering effects that set enemies up for finisher attacks also makes them take increased damage from regular melee attacks due to stealth damage bonus.
- Enemies affected by Savage Silence also take increased Finisher damage from Warframe abilities that deal Finisher damage, notably Blade Storm.
- Approaching stunned enemies upfront and killing them won't break the stealth affinity multiplier.
  - In similar fashion, bumping into stunned enemies won't break the multiplier either.
Conseils :
- Synergizes well with the Zakti pistol, as the Gas explosions will open enemies to finishers, allowing Banshee to simply have Silence active to deal increased Finisher damage on any enemy without needing low range or duration to re-stun enemies.
- Can allow for consistent proccing of on-finisher effects, such as Arcane Trickery and Arcane Ultimatum.
Savior Decoy:
- After switching places with the player, Savior Decoy has a 60-second cooldown during which it will be unable to absorb any fatal damage dealt.
- Grants 3s of Invulnerability
- Works beyond the range of Switch Teleport (probably infinite) and does not require direct line of sight.
Conseils :
- Synergizes very well with Limbo, as his Banish can protect the decoy from harm allowing a guaranteed activation of the augment.
- Enemies will surround and target the decoy if left out in the open. This is especially difficult to utilize against Infested who will rush the decoy and destroy it in just a few attacks. This makes the augment rather counterintuitive since if Loki himself takes fatal damage, and assuming his decoy is still alive, he will be teleported into a group of enemies with only a tiny bit of health.
  - Because of this, it's recommended to place the decoy in a hidden place far from enemies. However, finding a spot where enemies both cannot attack it can be very difficult, as the game will prevent it from being obstructed and most enemies can jump to almost any spot in the game.
Seeking Shuriken:
- Armor reduction is affected by Ability Strength, fully removing armor at 143% Ability Strength.
  - This can be easily reached (without penalties) using either a combination of Intensify and Power Drift, or an Umbral Intensify.
- Duration of armor reduction is affected by Ability Duration.
  - Subsequent Shuriken refresh the duration of the armor reduction.
  - The armor reduction of multiple Shuriken can stack.
- Despite Shuriken seeking through walls, the armor reduction requires line of sight.
- Affected enemies have a green aura around them identical to that of a Corrosive proc.
Conseils :
- With one player using Corrosive Projection, 100% armor strip can be achieved with 118% Ability Strength.
Shadow Haze:
- Critical chance bonus is affected by Sevagoth's Ability Strength.
- Critical chance bonus is applied additively after mods, the same way as Arcane Avenger and Covenant.
  - For example, a Baza Prime with a rank 5 Point Strike affected by Reap with a rank 5 Intensify will have 28% × (1 + 150%) + (50% × (1 + 30%)) = 135% critical chance.
  - The bonus does not apply to radial attacks on weapons such as Ogris.
  - The bonus does not work on abilities that are able to land critical hits, like Nova's Null Star, Wisp's Breach Surge or Vauban's Minelayer.
  - The bonus will apply to Amps.
- Shadow Haze can only be equipped on Sevagoth himself, but grants its effects to Sevagoth's Shadow via its Death's Harvest ability.
  - The critical chance bonus would still be determined by the Ability Strength of Sevagoth.
  - The flying lifespan and area of effect's radius of shadows spawned by Death's Harvest are determined by the Ability Duration and Ability Range of Sevagoth, while the Damage Vulnerability of Death's Harvest applied by the shadows are determined by the Ability Strength and Ability Duration of Sevagoth's Shadow.
- The Damage Vulnerability's duration that the Shadows spread is determined by the remaining duration of the debuff in the enemy they spawned from.
  - For example, if an enemy debuffed by Reap or Death's Harvest has 6 seconds left on it's debuff timer and then killed, the spawned Shadow will spread the same debuff lasting for 6 seconds on new enemies.
- Spawned Shadows take flight toward the direction their enemy host was facing and travel at the regular flight speed of Reap's tap-cast (10 m/s).
  - Shadows auto-lock to the closest enemy yet unaffected by Reap or Death's Harvest, within a 30 meters detection range around each Shadow.
  - When Shadows seek unaffected enemies, they speed up by an additional 50% and utilize enemy melee AI pathing (using stairs rather than fly up or down) to find their targets.
- Each Shadow is considered a new instance of Reap, inflicting their Radiation damage, debuffing enemies with Death's Harvest, and triggering ability interactions with Sevagoth's Death Well passive and Sow. Multiple spawned Shadows can damage enemies affected by previous Shadows.
  - Cannot be controlled via Sevagoth player's aiming down sights.
  - New Shadows cannot spawn from killing affected enemies when at max number of active Shadows.
  - Tracked on the minimap as blue allied dots.
- The 3 Shadow limit is on additional Shadows; it does not include the original Shadow summoned by casting Reap. Counting the original Shadow, up to 4 Shadows can be active at once.
  - This limit is not affected by Mods.
  - Recasting Reap will replace the original Shadow, leaving any Shadows created by Shadow Haze unaffected.
Shattered Storm:
- This augment causes the explosion from Mass Vitrify to apply the effects of Splinter Storm to all enemies hit as if they had been targeted by Splinter Storm, albeit with modified Power Strength.
- The enemy-target version of Splinter Storm creates an aura that deals damage per second within a radius, as well as causing the target enemy to be more vulnerable to damage.
  - The damage over time does not accumulate damage as with allied targets, nor does it benefit from any accumulated damage prior to casting.
  - The damage vulnerability applied by Splinter Shield does not benefit the instigating damage from Mass Vitrify, but will benefit subsequent casts of Mass Vitrify.
- Mending Splinters will count enemies affected by this augment.
Shield Of Shadows:
- Nekros will redirect a percentage of any damage taken and any Status Effect to his Shadows. Total damage redirection is determined by the number of Shadows linked to Nekros.
  - Total damage redirection is capped at 90%. This is obtainable by increasing Ability Strength to 215%, assuming 7 Shadows are active and linked to Nekros.
  - By cloning summoning units such as Drahk Masters or Corpus Techs and having those summon their respective minions, it is possible to have more than 7 Shadows. These minions behave like normal Shadows and the ability icon will show the increased number of shadows. They will be linked to Nekros, suffer from health decay and contribute to the damage redirection, which is, however, still capped at 90%.
- While Shadows of the Dead is active, Nekros is linked to all his shadows within range via energy threads of the chosen energy color.
- Damage redirection only begins at the end of Shadows of the Dead casting animation, when all shadows have spawned and Nekros is visually linked to them.
Shock Trooper:
- Damage bonus is affected by Ability Strength.
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
- Adds Electricity damage to weapon attacks. This damage bonus does not combine with other elements, and is additive with elemental mods.
- Multiple Shock Troopers do not stack; the buff with the highest Ability Strength will take effect.
  - However if a weaker buff with more Ability Duration is cast, it will take effect after the stronger buff expires.
- Electric damage from weapons buffed by Shock Trooper does not activate the passive from Archon Stretch.
- Does not apply to Archguns.
- Does not apply to Exalted Weapon.
Shocking Speed:
- A wavy energy halo will surround Volt and affected allies upon casting Speed, which serves as a visual indicator of the ability's radius.
  - Applies to each member affected by Speed for its entire duration.
- While a unit affected by Shocking Speed is moving, any enemy that touches the electric halo will immediately take 300 Electricity damage with a guaranteed electricity proc. This damage and status will occur once per second while the enemy is within the ability's 3m range.
  - The effect is active as long as Volt is moving, whether by walking, sprinting, using melee attacks, or performing maneuvers.
  - The 1 second cooldown between hits cannot be reset by having the enemy exit and re-enter the ability's radius.
- The guaranteed Electricity proc can be used to deal more damage with Condition Overload due to Shocking Speed's range being similar to the majority of melee weapon ranges, without casting any of Volt's other abilities.
- Also targets Storage Containers, Security Cameras, Sensor Bars, Arc Trap and Reinforced Glass.
Singularity:
- Cannot be used with Assimilate.
- Not affected by Ability Range.
- Not affected by Ability Strength.
- Vertical distance from enemies is not taken into account.
Smite Infusion:
- Damage bonus is affected by Ability Strength.
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
- Add Radiation damage to weapons, additive to IPS and elemental mods.
  - Does not increase the damage of most abilities, including Exalted Weapons.
  - Does not merge with Heat or Electricity
    - For example, with a weapon with base damage of 100 Impact per bullet, the mod Hellfire at max rank, and the buff from Smite Infusion at max rank with 110 strength, the damage will be: 100 Impact, 90 Heat, and 110 Radiation.
    - In this situation, if a status proc, it will have 100/300 chance to be Impact, 90/300 chance to be Heat, and 110/300 to be Radiation.
- For more information on how this augment works, see Buff & Debuff page.
- Multiple Smite Infusions do not stack; the buff with the highest Ability Strength will take effect.
  - However if a weaker instance with more Ability Duration is cast, it will take effect after the stronger buff expires.
Smoke Shadow:
- Allied cloak duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Allied cloak radius is affected by Ability Range.
- Teammates must be within range to receive the cast, after receiving the cast they can move away and still be cloaked.
- The increased Critical Hit chance is additive to mods like Point Strike, Pistol Gambit, and Blood Rush.
  - Example: A Vectis with Point Strike and cloaked by Smoke Shadow will have 25% * (1 + 1.5 + 1.5) = 100% critical chance.
  - Affects all weapon types including Archguns and Exalted Weapons, as long as the cloak buff remains.
  - Critical chance is not affected by mods.
  - Critical chance bonus is only applied when invisible from Smoke Shadow. Other forms of invisibility with this augment equipped will not grant the bonus.
- The increased critical chance bonus from different players stacks, up to 600% bonus critical chance from 4 players.
- Allied cloak duration is independent of Smoke Screen's rank. If Ash's Smoke Screen is of a lower rank than Smoke Shadow, it will be recastable before Smoke Shadow wears off, and thus allied cloak can be refreshed before its initial duration ends.
- Allied cloak duration can be increased by Ash getting teleport finisher kills while using the Teleport Rush augment, allowing Ash to refresh allied smoke shadow duration without needing to regroup.
- Allied cloak can be dispelled by Nullifier bubbles, but not by Dispel .
- Allies benefit from Stealth Damage Multipliers on melee attacks while cloaked.
- Allies affected by Smoke Shadow include some NPCs such as Syndicate Operatives and Rescue Targets, however Defense Operatives and Kavor Defectors are not included.
Sonic Siphon:
- Banshee gains 50 bonus Armor for each enemy hit by Sonic Boom up to a cap of 1500 Armor, lasting for 20 seconds.
  - Armor cap is not affected by Ability Strength.
  - Additional casts of Sonic Siphon will stack, increasing the armor value of the existing Sonic Siphon buff until the cap is reached.
  - Hitting at least one enemy with Sonic Siphon will fully refresh the buff duration, maintaining the current armor buff.
- The effect will trigger even if struck enemies have no armor.
- Armor cap is reached after a total of 30 enemy hits, decreasing when Ability Strength is increased.
