Soul Survivor:
- Instantly revives the downed ally target on cast with a percentage of their maximum health.
  - Can revive downed players and Companions.
  - The percentage of health restored is affected by Ability Strength.
- Can revive allied targets repeatedly as long as Nekros has enough energy for Soul Punch.
- Revived allies receive 2 seconds of Invulnerability.
- Reviving with Soul Punch also counts towards Challenges that count Revives.
Conseils :
- Synergizes well with Despoil, as it allows one to continue Desecrating while saving Energy for emergency Revives.
  - Combining this with Equilibrium will also allow Nekros to chain revives as long as he gathers health orbs to create the energy for casting Soul Punch.
Spectral Spirit:
- Cooldown reduction per kill is not affected by mods.
- Unlike the base ability, Dagath will only gain the critical damage bonus provided by Grave Spirit while she is in her spectral form.
  - In addition shields will restore normally while using this ability.
- Subsuming Doom for another ability will prevent players from modifying the Phantom Wrath debuff associated with Doom.
- Grave Spirit only doubles the damage stored by Phantom Wrath when in her physical form. As this augment restricts Dagath exclusively to her spectral form, this synergy is effectively removed.
- With this augment, Grave Spirit can be dispelled, such as Silence from Violence, and immediately forced into cooldown.
- Damaging abilities and weapons will apply Doom to enemies.
  - Abilities that do not deal damage on cast (e.g. Breach Surge) will not apply the Doom effect on cast.
Conseils :
- Pairs well with Equilibrium and Violet Archon Shards since kills in spectral form have a 100% chance to drop a Health Orb, which allows for easy energy generation.
Spectrosiphon:
- Drop chance is not affected by Ability Strength.
- Spectrosiphon affects enemies that die within Spectrorage's charm radius, which extends 4 meters beyond the ring of mirrors. Both the ring and the charm radius are affected by Ability Range.
Conseils :
- This mod synergizes very well with anything that can help pull enemies into a cluster within the ring of mirrors and thus generate a higher chance at yielding energy orbs, such as Proboscis Cernos, Nidus's Larva, Vauban's Bastille in Vortex mode, Khora's Ensnare, Mag's short-tap Magnetize, Yareli's Riptide, Gyre's detonated Coil Horizon, the Vazarin school's Void Snare, or Nautilus's Cordon precept.
- As drop chance is unaffected by Ability Strength, players can focus on maximizing Spectrorage's area via Overextended.
Spellbound Harvest:
- Energy gain scales with Ability Strength.
- Spellbound Harvest still recovers energy even under the effects of Razorwing, or any other channeled ability.
- Does not benefit frames without Energy (e.g. Hildryn, and Lavos).
- Energy will only be granted if at least 4 of the hit enemies are not floating.
  - Repeatedly hit 4 or more enemies with Overguard to rapidly generate energy.
- First cast the ability on a tight group of enemies (e.g. in a doorway or near a Lantern) to receive the Ability Range bonus.
  - Successful hits with the augment give Spellbind +2m "radius" for a total radius of 7m (going from 10m to 14m wide). This is effectively an additional Stretch or Augur Reach applied only to Spellbind.
Staggering Shield:
- Stagger chance is affected by Ability Strength, to a cap at 100% at 200% Ability Strength.
- The stagger effect imparted upon reflected shots takes the form of an Impact proc.
Surging Blades:
- The thrown bubble has infinite body punch through and deals damage in about a 4m diameter, with a guaranteed Slash status effect on hit.
- Throwing the bubble does not prematurely end the ability.
- The accumulated damage boost affects only the thrown blade and not the orbiting blades around the Warframe.
  - However, the damage boost can be accumulated by both the rotating and thrown blades.
  - The accumulated bonus damage is displayed together with an Aquablades icon on the player's buffs UI.
  - The rate of damage increase is a flat additive 10% of the starting damage of Aquablades, and this 10% rate is not increased by Ability Strength mods; however, since the starting damage is affected by Ability Strength, the accumulated rate of damage increase per thrown blade is still better with higher Strength mod builds.
  - The accumulated damage will expire once the blades around the Warframe expire.
- The throw costs 15 energy, affected by Ability Efficiency.
  - While riding Merulina, the throw consumes 0 energy.
- Throwing range and splash area of effect are not affected by Ability Range.
- The speed of the throwing animation is increased while riding Merulina and with Natural Talent.
- Has a hidden synergy with the Kompressa where Surging Blades can be shot into Kompressa's bubble clusters before they pop. The bubble grows to about 3m in diameter and pulses damage once per second over 20 seconds (not affected by Ability Duration). Up to ten of these bubbles can be created at a time.
  - These bubbles will inherit the current accumulated damage bonus.
  - Enemies hit by the damage pulses will also increase the current damage bonus, but the damage of each bubble is fixed at the time of its creation; any increased damage bonus will be applied to new bubbles.
  - This interaction also works with other bubble type powers, including Magnetize or enemy Arctic Eximus bubbles.
    - With Magnetize, the bubbles may not form properly if there are objects like walls or boxes within range of the spinning blades.
Conseils :
- The throw is still discounted to 0 with Loyal Merulina.
- A Duration-based build allows the Aquablades user to stack much more damage while spamming Surging Blades.
  - Narrow Minded is a viable option for such above build, as its Ability Range penalty has no effect on a blade's AoE splash range.
  - Yareli benefits even further from this build, as riding Merulina allows her to spam thrown blades at zero energy cost and racking up damage in the process. She can even forego of Efficiency builds and instead build on Ability Strength (such as by equipping Blind Rage) to further amplify her blades.
- Due to their damage revolving around Slash, the thrown blades are noticeably more effective on Infested and Grineer enemies, and less so on shielded Corpus.
  - When Aquablades does get a high enough damage accumulation, the Bleed proc makes short work of shields, especially when combined with Magnetic status effects.
- Due to having infinite body punch through, the blade has great synergy with Magnetize.
Surging Dash:
- Combo Counter hits per enemy is affected by Ability Strength.
- The listed Combo Counter increases are additional values to Slash Dash's hit counter. At max rank, a single hit with Slash Dash will instantly add 9 hits to the Combo Counter.
- Mods that affect combo count per hit, such as True Punishment affects the modified end result of your combo count after Surging Dash's calculations.
  - For example, using the full Umbral set with max ranked Umbral Intensify (for a total of 177% strength), using Surging Dash will give a total of 15combo count points. With True Punishment equipped on your melee, you will gain 30 combo count points.
Swift Bite:
- Range increase is additive with other sources of Ability Range.
- Cooldown reduction is affected by Ability Efficiency.
Target Fixation:
- Enemies hit by either Tail Wind itself or its variants, Hover Jump and Dive Bomb, will increase the damage bonus.
  - Damage increase is not affected by Ability Strength.
- Damage bonus is reset after staying on the ground or wall latching for 2 seconds.
  - Time until reset is not affected by Ability Duration.
  - Using Tail Wind on ground level will prevent the reset, making it possible to be used indefinitely.
- Bullet Jumping will override Tail Wind's velocity, providing more directional control after the flight.
- Dead corpses of enemies count towards the damage increase.
  - Corpses that disappear, such as enemies killed under the effect of Nukor/Kuva Nukor's microwave effect, do not count anymore towards the damage increase once the body dissolving animation ends.
- Damage bonus has no limit and can scale infinitely, making it one of the easiest sources of reaching Warframe's damage cap with enough time.
- Does not reset upon respawning. However dying or a host migration triggering will reset the bonus.
Conseils :
- Ability Duration lower than 80% makes hitting enemies with Tail Wind difficult, not granting any damage bonus as a result. Hover Jump and Dive Bomb still function normally, however.
- Getting knocked down can force you to be grounded for too long. Make sure to trigger a faster recovery by jumping when Zephyr is flashing to prevent losing the buff. Alternatively having the Motus Set fully equipped makes this a non-issue.
- Entering Operator mode while Zephyr is airborne makes it possible to maintain the buff. The Operator does not have to adhere to the conditions of the buff, so long as Zephyr is midair upon entering Operator mode. This same rule applies to similar buffs, such as Aerial Bond. This makes it possible to perform actions such as hacking and reviving that would normally force you to lose the buff.
  - Hold casting Tail Wind before transferring to Operator does let Zephyr stay flying in the air; however, it does not count as air-born while in Operator form and will still remove the buff.
- Wall latching counts as being grounded and will reset the bonus if left latching for 2 seconds. Entering an Archwing will also reset the bonus after two seconds even if remaining fully airborne.
  - The augment's side benefit of resetting double jumps can help for mobility in moving around open worlds simply using Zephyr's abilities, lessening the pain of forgoing an archwing if wanting to retain the buff.
- Dive bombing with the empowered Tail Wind into a group of armor stripped enemies affected by Tornado or Funnel Clouds and by Viral status effects will ensure massive damage.
- Can easily scale any damage on Tail wind/Dive bomb by itself. As Zephyr's other abilities are mostly for utility and the augment does not directly scale from ability strength, this makes it viable to run a build with Overextended to help strike even more targets at once.
  - A subtle benefit is that lower strength ensures Tornado wont kill enemies and instead keeps them grouped up, allowing you to use them to further scale the damage bonus. This also lets it and Airburst group even more enemies for even more damage scaling.
Tectonic Fracture:
- As this Augment prevents the Bulwarks from turning into Boulders, Petrify will no longer affect Bulwarks.
Conseils :
- Tectonic Fracture gives Atlas additional defensive tactics in different Mission types:
  - In Interception missions, the Bulwarks can be placed "in" the towers' control consoles, forcing the enemy to destroy the Bulwarks and making a given tower "immune" to enemy capture until a Bulwark is destroyed. Two Atlases with this augment can protect up three towers this way. The Bulwarks can be placed too far inside the consoles, allowing enemies to capture the point anyway, so players must line the Bulwarks carefully.
  - In The Index, properly-placed Bulwarks can prevent enemy Brokers from accessing the Tenno's bank and scoring points.
  - In Sortie Defense missions, the Bulwarks can be used to wall in the Tenno Operative, preventing them from wandering around the map and exposing themselves (and by extension, the players) to enemy fire. Bear in mind that this tactic is not foolproof, as the Operative will teleport out of the "box" after enough time has passed.
Teeming Virulence:
- Critical chance bonus is affected by Ability Strength, including Nidus' passive rank bonus.
- Critical chance bonus is additive to critical hit mods.
  - For example, a Snipetron with a max rank Point Strike and +200% critical chance bonus will have a 30% × (1 + 150% + 200%) =135% critical chance.
- Bonus duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Parasitic Link's second instance of Virulence counts toward the trigger condition of this mod, meaning a minimum of 2 enemies can trigger the buff if they simultaneously get hit by both Virulence from Nidus and from his Parasitic Link's target.
- Archguns are not considered Primary Weapons and are unaffected by the mod.
Conseils :
- Provides a more significant damage output boost for primaries with high base critical chance.
Teleport Rush: - Teleport Rush can be used to refresh the duration of smoke bomb on allies when using the Smoke Shadow augment. This allows the invisibility to be maintained on teammates without needing to regroup.
Temporal Artillery:
- Combo Count Cap is not affected by mods.
- The augment requires an active Blaze Artillery, and will pick the closest one in a ?m range (possibly infinite).
  - Artillery that was picked up no longer has its 130deg frontal cone, allowing it to target all enemies within range.
    - If there is no enemy in sight/range, the artillery will aim where the player aims (with a slight delay).
  - If the picked artillery had a combo greater than 20x, it will be set to 20x.
- When Temporal Anchor ends, the artillery will be released and will function as normal (i.e. aiming in a 130deg cone, and able to go past 20x combo).
- 2 more normal (stationary) Blaze Artillery units can be created.
  - Casting past the max count limit of 3 will replace one of the stationary artilleries.
Temporal Erosion:
- Armor reduction is affected by Ability Strength.
Conseils :
- Modding for Ability Duration can allow Temporal Anchor to last longer, allowing more uptime on the armor strip and less activating or deactivating of the ability.
Tesla Bank:
- Burst radius is affected by Ability Range.
- Damage dealt is based on the percentage of the target's total unarmored health (including Shields) after the Nervos first attaches (e.g. it will deal 80% of the target's health (minus the attachment damage) upon death if it attached when the target was at 80% health).
- Damage to health can be from any source; it does not have to be damage dealt by Nervos.
- Damage is unaffected by Ability Strength.
- Damage is dealt per attached Nervos (e.g. if 4 Nervos attach to a target at 100% health, they will each deal 100% of the target's health (minus the attachment damage) upon death)
- Only deals damage to those it has Line of Sight to.
- Total damage from a single Nervos uncommonly reaches 100% of the enemy's health, as the initial attachment damage is inflicted before the health is set (e.g. if the Nervos deals 25 damage per second, and attaches to an enemy with 100 health, it will only be able to deal a 75 damage burst upon death).
  - The 100% health damage can only be achieved if enemies were invulnerable while getting attached (e.g. certain Deep Archimedea conditions), or if an enemy has an amount of Overguard equal to, or greater than, the Nervos' damage (e.g. if the Nervos deals 25 damage per second, and it attaches to an enemy with 100 health and 25 or more Overguard, it will be able to deal a 100 damage burst upon death).
  - This also means that enemies killed by the first instance of damage will not cause any radial burst.
- Removing Armor and utilizing Viral procs can greatly increase damage to other enemies.
Tharros Lethality:
- Debuff lasts for 10 seconds.
  - Affected enemies have a gust of energy surrounding them.
- Critical Damage bonus is additive with Vital Sense, Target Cracker, Organ Shatter, and similar buffs.
- Scales with Ability Strength.
- The Critical Damage buff also applies to Amp Critical Damage
  - This Critical Damage buff to Amps does increase Amp Critical Damage against the specter forms of Thrax Centurion and Thrax Legatus, including their Lua versions. Tharros Strike must be used on their non-spectral forms for the Critical Damage buff to apply.
The Relentless Lost:
- Bonuses are not affected by mods.
- Casting The Lost with this augment equipped will automatically cycle to the next sub-ability.
  - Releasing a Gazed target will neither contribute nor cancel out the bonus, and will not automatically cycle to Deny.
Thermal Transfer:
- Tap cast grants Cold damage. Hold cast grants Heat damage.
  - Both fields can exist simultaneously, granting each elemental buff separately.
  - If a player obtains both elemental buffs, they combine into a Blast buff, equaling the sum of Cold and Heat damage.
  - Bonus damage does not combine with modded elements, and is additive with elemental mods.
  - Does not affect exalted weapons or warframe abilities.
- Duration is refreshed and paused indefinitely while standing in the Thermal Sunder field.
  - Cold and Heat fields refresh the duration of the corresponding buffs; the Blast damage buff duration is paused in any of the fields.
- Sunder areas gain an inward pulsing visual effect to indicate Thermal Transfer is equipped.
- The caster and allies see the Thermal Transfer Cold, Heat, or Blast bonus as separate buff icons with a value of the elemental damage added and the remaining duration in seconds.
- Elemental Damage bonus scales with Ability Strength.
- Buff duration scales with Ability Duration
- For status damage purposes Heat bonus is additive with other Heat damage bonuses, while Blast does not contribute towards status damage.
Thrall Pact:
- Damage bonus is affected by Ability Strength.
- The damage bonus from Thrall Pact stacks additively with damage bonuses such as Serration, Galvanized Aptitude, and Primary Merciless.
- The modified damage can be calculated using the following formula:
  - Modified Damage = Base Damage × (1 + Thrall Pact Bonus × (1 + Ability Strength) × Number of Enthralled Enemies + Damage Mods)
  - For example, with a max rank Serration and Intensify, 4 enthralled enemies, and a weapon that deals 100 damage, the total modified damage will be: 100 × (1 + 0.25 × (1 + 0.3) × 4 + 1.65) = 395
Tidal Impunity:
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Status effect immunity includes protection against stun, stagger, and knockdown which is reduced to a minor knockback effect.
- Affected players are enveloped by water tinted with their selected energy color for the duration.
- Reduces Tidal Surge combo casts to 7.5 energy.
Titanic Rumbler:
- At max rank and without other mods, Titanic Rumbler will cause Atlas to spawn a single, larger Rumbler with 18,000 health, 8,000 punch damage and 2,000 rock throw damage.
  - Health is affected by Health and Shield mods.
  - Health and base damage are affected by Ability Strength. The damage multiplier is not additionally scaled by Ability Strength.
- While Titanic Rumbler is equipped, reactivating the ability will make the Rumbler taunt nearby enemies and perform a slam attack that inflicts 500 Impact damage in a 15 meter radius.
  - Slam attack has a static cooldown of 6 seconds.
  - Slam attack is not affected by the augment's 400% damage multiplier.
  - Slam damage is not affected by Summoner's Wrath, Nourish, or even Roar (regardless of the buff being applied to Atlas himself or to the Rumbler).
- Atlas cannot unsummon the Rumbler while Titanic Rumbler is equipped.
Total Eclipse:
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
- Affected Defense Objects cap their damage reduction at 50%.
- Total Eclipse applies to other players, Companions, Specters, friendly AI and Mirage's Hall of Mirrors dopplegangers
  - Total Eclipse also appears to apply to ability-related specters of other Warframes when Eclipse is subsumed, including Celestial Twin, Metamorphosis with Duality, Shadows of the Dead.
- Eclipse's bonus will add separately from other damage-bonus augments (such as Freeze Force), though it will still affect modded elemental values when applied on weapons.
- A Mirage under the effects of both her own Eclipse and an allied Total Eclipse will only benefit from her own Eclipse. The allied Total Eclipse will not stack.
Transistor Shield:
- Damage absorbed is directly affected by Ability Strength.
  - Any damage absorbed by Electric Shield will contribute to Volt's Static Discharge passive, but it cannot exceed the 1000 damage cap on the passive itself.
Tribunal:
- Effect percentage is not affected by mods.
- Harrow must have Penance and/or Thurible active to allow allies to proc their effects from enemies chained by Condemn.
- Allies gain the lifesteal on hit from Penance, and energy per kill or per headshot kill from Thurible. Harrow also gains the health and energy earned by his allies.
- Health and energy points earned from allies are shown to Harrow on his HUD pertaining to the respective abilities. Health points beneath the aiming reticle, and energy notification messages above the ability icons.
Ulfrun's Endurance:
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
- Despite its description, the augment only restores a charge if the enemy directly targeted by the lunge attack dies instantly or due to the Slash procs from abilities such as Ulfrun's Descent or Fangs of Raksh while in range. This also applies to helminth abilities such as Aquablades, as long as the Slash proc is caused by an ability Voruna has cast. This includes inflicting a Slash proc with a weapon, then duplicating it with Sickening Pulse, since the duplicated procs are created by an ability. Slash procs made by ally abilities do not count for restoring charges.
  - Nearby enemies who die due to the radial Slash damage do not restore charges.
Conseils :
- When targeting a durable enemy, it is best to wait for them to die due to the innate Slash proc instead of lunging for a second time to save charges.
- Equipping the augment is the only way to reach the maximum stacks of the damage multiplier, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage, as they can only be achieved after 5 direct kills.
- Using Fangs of Raksh can apply Slash procs, making it possible to regenerate charges without spending them, and can restore multiple charges due to the status effects spreading when the target dies.
Untime Rift:
- Instead of doubling The Vast Untime's Damage Vulnerability, this augment applies a second instance of it, meaning enemies take 125% more Void damage instead of 100%.
- Because Xata's Whisper is the only way for Xaku to gain Void status, this ability is effectively mandatory to properly use this augment mod.
- Untime Rift will continue to tether to new enemies affected by Void status after the initial casting of The Vast Untime.
- The Slow is capped at 95%, with Untime Rift it can be achieved using less Ability Strength.
Valence Formation:
- Upon casting an ability with an imbued element, grants a 200% Elemental Damage buff of the imbued element to all of Lavos's weapons for 20 seconds.
  - No buff will be granted when casting an ability with no element infused, or when casting Helminth abilities.
  - Only one elemental bonus can be active at a time. Casting another ability with a mixed element will replace it and refresh the duration.
- Bonus Elemental Damage will be added parallel to the weapon’s Elemental Damage, meaning it will NOT combine with elements on the weapon.
  - Damage bonus is additive to elemental damage bonuses like Heated Charge.
- Due to how status DoT damage is calculated, a Valence Formation buff for Heat, Electricity, Toxin, or Gas will also add 200% DoT damage to all procs of that specific element.
  - Blast damage is exempt, as its proc damage does not scale with elemental damage.
  - The bonus is additive to elemental damage bonuses like Heated Charge, and multiplicative to Faction Damage bonuses like Bane of Grineer and Status Damage bonuses like Rifle Elementalist.
  - The 200% bonus DoT damage also applies to matching status procs from all of Lavos's abilities, including Helminth abilities.
    - For example, a heat Valence Formation buff will triple the DoT damage from his Catalyze, heat-imbued Ophidian Bite, subsumed Thermal Sunder, etc. Note that the initial ability damage will be unaffected; only the resulting DoT will be increased.
    - Valence Formation buff is applied immediately on cast (before the ability finishes its animation), allowing the ability cast that grants the buff to also benefit from the bonus DoT damage (if applicable).
  - As the damage of the Gas status effect does not scale with equipped Heat and Toxin mods, Valence Formation is one of the few ways to increase its damage.
- Unlike most other buffs in the game, Valence Formation cannot be negated by nullifying bubble or enemy abilities, nor by jumping Out Of Bounds.
- Valence Formation is a Universal Weapon Bonus, meaning it not only applies to weapons but also to certain "weapon coded" abilities. Of the subsumable abilities, Valence Formation can give its elemental damage and guaranteed proc to Airburst (direct hits), Breach Surge, Null Star, Pyrotechnics, and Shuriken.
- Valence Formation is one of the only buffs in the game that affects the AoE explosion of Vile Discharge, though it will only add the guaranteed status effect, not the elemental damage.
  - However, the proc (except for Radiation) will affect Lavos if he is within range, unless he has Valence Block active to negate it.
Conseils :
- This allows Lavos to freely deal with enemy weaknesses such as removing armor with Corrosive while wielding a Viral-based weapon, or dealing with shields by adding Magnetic damage.
- Shotguns are ideal weapons to utilize with this augment, as each pellet will gain the boosted damage and proc the element on every hit.
  - Conversely, beam weapons may be less effective than expected, as modding for multishot will not increase the number of hits.
- Allows you to trigger Melee Influence on demand without needing to mod Electric on your melee weapon.
- Allows you to generate chain reactions with Pax Seeker.
- Can damage the Profit-Taker Orb's shields, allowing Lavos to adapt when she changes her elemental weaknesses.
- In some cases, it can be beneficial to use an unranked version of this mod so that the innate status effects on the weapon are more likely to happen, while the element from Valence Formation will still be guaranteed on hit.
- While Valence Formation does alter status weighting, the selected status is still applied in addition to normal status procs, effectively letting you "double up" by modding status normally then stacking Valence Formation on top.
Vampire Leech:
- Synergizes with Trinity's Blessing, allowing up to 75% damage reduction to be applied to the generated shields and overshields.
- The base 225% shield replenishment is not affected by any mods, however it is indirectly affected by Ability Strength as more overflowing energy per cast means more shields and overshields.
Vampiric Grasp: - Health restore is affected by Ability Strength.
Venari Bodyguard:
- Upon taking fatal damage, Khora becomes invulnerable for 3 seconds and has 50% of her health restored.
- Venari cannot be manually respawned after sacrificing herself. However, if she dies normally, she can be manually respawned.
- The kill and respawn timer, invulnerability duration and amount of health restored apparently can't be increased or decreased by mods.
- Considering the 150s cooldown and 4s cooldown reduction - you will have to kill ~37 enemies to immediately revive Venari and regain the Death Gate.
- This mod functions properly in Arbitrations, allowing a Khora player to have a buffer to being killed, as long as Venari is still alive.
- Oddly this mod is tagged as an augment for the Venari ability specfically, despite all of its effects relating to Khoras passive ability of simply having Venari and none of its effects synergising with the ability itself. This causes a minor gameplay issue, as if the ability is replaced via Helminth this augment cannot be equiped despite the fact it would function normally.
Venom Dose:
- Damage bonus is affected by Ability Strength.
- Duration is affected by Ability Duration.
- Range is affected by Ability Range.
- Cannot be equipped at the same time as Revealing Spores.
- Adds Corrosive damage to the weapon, added alongside IPS and elemental mods.
  - Does not increase the damage of most abilities, including Exalted Weapons.
  - Does not merge with Toxin or Electricity.
  - For example: for a weapon with a base damage of 100 Impact per bullet, with the mod Infected Clip at max rank, and the buff from Venom Dose at max rank with 110 strength, the damage will be: 100 Impact, 90 Toxin, and 110 Corrosive.
    - In this situation, if a status procs, it will have 100/300 chance to be Impact, 90/300 chance to be Toxin, and 110/300 to be Corrosive.
- For more information on how this augment works, see Buff & Debuff page.
- Multiple casts of Venom Dose do not stack; the buff with the highest Ability Strength will take effect.
  - However if a weaker one with more Ability Duration is cast, it will take effect after the stronger buff expires.
Vexing Retaliation:
- Vexing Retaliation will deal Puncture proc if receiving Shield damage, and Blast proc if receiving Health damage.
- The range of the damage procs is affected by Ability Range.
  - Requires Line of Sight to the target.
- The damage effect can trigger an unlimited number of times as long as Vex Armor is active.
Viral Tempest:
- Status chance for a Viral proc can be increased above 100% with Ability Strength, resulting in projectiles that can inflict more than 1 stack of Viral per hit.
- Augment does not negatively impact Tempest Barrage's guaranteed Corrosive proc on hit.
Volatile Recompense:
- Daggers deal 1,000 Blast Damage on each hit with a guaranteed Blast status.
- Daggers are not consumed upon hitting an enemy and will continuously generate Overguard and melee combo per hit.
  - With this augment, two daggers will seek out enemies every second and remain embedded for three seconds before returning to orbit Kullervo, with any orbiting daggers indicated on the UI. The ability otherwise behaves as normal (dealing self-damage if any daggers are still orbiting Kullervo when the ability ends, targeted enemies receiving a maximum of three daggers, and so on).
  - Struck enemies will not be targeted by following volleys until the daggers embedded in them expire. If no valid targets are in range, daggers will stop spawning until a valid target is in range.
  - The daggers generate Overguard every 0.6s as long as sufficient targets are in range.
    - If Kullervo's Overguard is depleted less than 0.1s after a dagger generates it, there will be an opening where attacks can damage his health before the next dagger can restore the gate.
- Cannot be recast while active.
Warding Thurible:
- Damage reduction and energy charge are affected by Ability Strength.
  - The damage reduction caps at 90%, achievable with a 180% Ability Strength.
- Affected allies includes all Warframes, Companions, Eidolon Lures, summoned allied units such as Specters, allied Invasion units, Hostages, Kavor Defectors, Sortie and Arbitrations Defense Operatives, and Defense Objects.
  - On Defense Objects, the damage reduction is capped at 50%.
- Despite it not being stated on the mod card, the damage reduction granted by the augment also applies to Harrow himself.
Warrior's Rest:
- Excalibur Umbra will normally turn into a Specter and fight independently while the player is using their Operator or Drifter, disabling any active abilities in the process and taking damage. This augment mod prevents this while also boosting Ability Strength slightly as compensation.
  - This allows channeled abilities such as Gloom to remain active instead of being disabled, and prevents damage to the Warframe while in Operator mode (if no abilities are active).
Wrecking Wall:
- Enemy armor and shields are fully removed at 200% Ability Strength. With one Corrosive Projection, armor will be fully stripped at 164% Ability Strength.
  - Shield strip removes a percentage of the current maximum value, as such it has diminishing returns on subsequent casts against the same enemies. Armor strip, however, is a percentage of an enemy's total, requiring only two casts at base strength to fully strip.
  - Defenses will only be stripped once enemies are crushed by both walls.
Conseils :
- As this augment refreshes empowered pillar duration, combine with Crucible Blast to prolong the inherited nuclear chain reaction on each pulse.
